tsa-a08-v01.quick_english: Which this world-born glory-natured, said to womb endless varied enjoyer-enjoyed — there whatever pervades as great-light-formed, that is like the great common, Supreme-Śiva-formed.

tsa-a08-v02.quick_english: But whatever form pervading only some differences, that is a category — as earth called of glow-hardness-bulk-and-rest form, pervading all world-eggs ruled by world-lords from Kālāgni to Vīrabhadra.

tsa-a08-v03.quick_english: There of these categories cause-effect-ness is shown; and it is twofold.

tsa-a08-v05.quick_english: There the ultimate cause-effect-ness is this much: which, namely, of the agent-natured, free Lord, with such from-Śiva-to-earth-ended body, non-different in nature and resting in own nature — showing-forth.

tsa-a08-v06.quick_english: But the constructed cause-effect-ness, made by the Lord's will: and as long as, when fixed before-after appearing, being even in the more, following own nature, only so far — by that from yogin's wish too, sprout from seed too, in dream and the rest, from pots and the rest, even thus —

tsa-a08-v07.quick_english: And there too, of the Supreme Lord non-loss of agency — thus even unconstructed, that ultimate stands firm.

tsa-a08-v08.quick_english: For with the ultimate wall-like standing form, all this drawn is fitting, not otherwise. Hence by the assemblage alone is caused-ness fitting.

tsa-a08-v09.quick_english: For it, made of the weave of all beings, by free-awareness greatness, thus of fixed own place-time-thing-mass nature — each thing-nature completed, being thus; for of being-thus, being-otherwise — as it increases, so the effect's other-kind-ness by degrees nourishes.

tsa-a08-v10.quick_english: Thus the free-awareness-natured Supreme Lord alone, world-thing-bodied, is the maker of pots and the rest — since potter-awareness, from not being greater, and the potter's body placed amid the thing-mass — how is the potter-body's maker-pride? Thus — if Lord-made even that will be, like pots and the rest.

tsa-a08-v11.quick_english: Hence the assemblage-doctrine too strengthens makership of awareness alone, the world-bodied.

tsa-a08-v12.quick_english: For a pot such as would be there on Meru would not be.

tsa-a08-v13.quick_english: Thus in the constructed caused-ness, the many-typed-ness toward categories' cause-effect-ness in scriptures — that too fits — from dung worms, from yogin's wish, from mantra, from herbs: like scorpion-arising.

tsa-a08-v14.quick_english: There by own-system view we show the constructed.

tsa-a08-v15.quick_english: There the Supreme Lord, full with five powers — thus said; he by freedom manifesting power after power chiefly stands fivefold.

tsa-a08-v16.quick_english: Where awareness leads: Śiva-principle; where bliss leads: power-principle; where will leads: Sadāśiva-principle — for will, of knowing and doing, is of even-acceptance nature; where knowledge-power leads: Īśvara-principle; where action-power leads: knowledge-principle — thus.

tsa-a08-v17.quick_english: And here the category-lords: Śiva, Śakti, Sadāśiva, Īśvara, Ananta — like Brahmā in withdrawal; of these common-formed, the particulars with pervasion for object are five — namely Śāmbhavas, Śāktas, Mantramāheśvaras, Mantreśvaras, Mantras — thus the pure path.

tsa-a08-v18.quick_english: So far directly Śiva is maker; but the impure path Aghoreśa, also called Ananta, emits — by the Lord's will-sway, for the enjoyment-perfection of atoms wavered by craving.

tsa-a08-v19.quick_english: There the waverer, not-full, other-natured form, throbbing, actionless, mere longing — will be future fitness for bounding, thus — is not impurity of man, nor another category.

tsa-a08-v20.quick_english: But passion-principle is longing bounded by action.

tsa-a08-v21.quick_english: But action there is mere action; mind-nature is passion, varied by action-difference — thus the distinction will be told.

tsa-a08-v22.quick_english: It is this impurity from the Supreme Lord's self-veiling wish — nothing else at all; and that too by that Lord-wish-nature alone is the thingness of earth and the rest.

tsa-a08-v23.quick_english: And it, impurity, existing in the knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction — thus does not fatten its own effect, action.

tsa-a08-v24.quick_english: But of the dissolution-kevalin, merely yawning it has been — thus impurity-strengthened action is the cause in transmigration-variety enjoyment — thus for the enjoyment-perfection of atoms pierced by enjoyment-latency of that, glorious Aghoreśa emits — thus it is said fittingly: and the stirring of impurity is by Lord-wish-force alone, for of the inert by itself, anywhere at all, is inability.

tsa-a08-v25.quick_english: An atom, indeed, is called mere shining of conscious-unconscious-form; of it conscious-form is lordliness alone, unconscious-formedness alone is impurity. And of it emitting, by Lord-wish-made, and thence always of the ever-to-be-emitted-thing-abiding form's to-be-shown-as-inert-ness, inert, all-effect-pervading-formed and pervasive is Māyā-called principle, the material cause; and showing it forth is the Supreme Lord's power named Māyā, quite other than that.

tsa-a08-v26.quick_english: Thus of kalā-and-rest principles to earth-ended too two-formedness is to be described.

tsa-a08-v27.quick_english: And here proof too have said Abhinavagupta's gurus in two-formedness.

tsa-a08-v28.quick_english: Which in resolve shines, that separated too exists outside, with clear form — like a pot.

tsa-a08-v29.quick_english: And thus of Māyā-kalā-and-sky-flowers and the rest too this very course — thus the purely affirmative reason.

tsa-a08-v30.quick_english: And by this, those who enjoy knowing of direct-realization-form with Māyā-kalā-nature-mind and the rest as object — they too are perfected, perfected alone.

tsa-a08-v31.quick_english: Thus standing, from Māyā-principle is world-birth.

tsa-a08-v32.quick_english: And it though indeed non-sequential alone, yet by the stated view sequence appears — thus.

tsa-a08-v33.quick_english: That too is told: there per self the kalā-and-rest group is divided.

tsa-a08-v34.quick_english: From its effect's makership-strengthening and the rest, by self-difference found — but that group sometimes might become one too, by the Lord's wish, like social selves — there all this kalā-and-rest group is pure, which by Lord-objectedness, fit for gaining its nature, doing own work, from world-opposition.

tsa-a08-v35.quick_english: And it becomes thus by the Supreme Lord's power-descent sway — thus we shall tell in its showing.

tsa-a08-v36.quick_english: But the impure is opposite of that.

tsa-a08-v37.quick_english: There from Māyā kalā is born, which yokes the sleeping-placed atom with slight makership; and she, as if swelling, from the union of the two, Māyā and atom, though arisen deforms Māyā, not the undeformable atom — thus Māyā-effect-ness of her.

tsa-a08-v38.quick_english: Thus from mutual clinging, indistinguishable inwardness of man-and-kalā.

tsa-a08-v39.quick_english: Māyā-womb officers, but by some lord's grace, when all action ends, Māyā-man discrimination comes about — by which above Māyā sits the knowledge-kevalin; never ever below Māyā is kalā-man discrimination, by which one stands above kalā.

tsa-a08-v40.quick_english: Or nature-man discrimination, by which below the chief one would not transmigrate.

tsa-a08-v42.quick_english: But when man's fullness is seen, Śiva-ness alone.

tsa-a08-v43.quick_english: Thus kalā-principle alone is slight-makership-giving, not —

tsa-a08-v45.quick_english: Slight-knowing-giving impure knowledge is born from kalā; and knowledge sees mind, and grasps its-lying parts and pleasures and the rest with discrimination.

tsa-a08-v46.quick_english: Of mind, of quality-confused form, with discrimination to grasp, from inability.

tsa-a08-v47.quick_english: Hence the mind-mirrored being is discerned by knowledge.

tsa-a08-v48.quick_english: Slight-makership, to perfect some part, somewhere alone makership — in this sense it comes down; but somewhere too in this part is passion-principle's business.

tsa-a08-v49.quick_english: Not from non-dispassion-made is that — even of non-dispassion, from seeing no-attachment.

tsa-a08-v50.quick_english: In dispassion, even in duty and the rest, attachment is seen.

tsa-a08-v51.quick_english: And of the sated in food and the rest, though non-dispassion absent, from unremoved inner passion.

tsa-a08-v52.quick_english: By that, without again — from non-dispassion-non-arising contingency.

tsa-a08-v53.quick_english: And time, effect reckoning, reckons makership too bounded by that — in the like, in some-where-ness, this alone makership — thus in this sense is necessity's business.

tsa-a08-v54.quick_english: In cause-effect-ness too her alone is the business; by that from kalā alone this fourfold is born — this very, slightly now knowing, clinging, I do — thus formed awareness, gone to body-city-eight and the rest, beast thus is called.

tsa-a08-v55.quick_english: That this Māyā-and-rest six is called six sheaths.

tsa-a08-v56.quick_english: Of awareness by Māyā, from being set aside, of kalā and the rest falling above, like sheaths from standing.

tsa-a08-v57.quick_english: Thus slight-makership which is Māyā-effect — there the slight, undistinguished which makership, to be qualified — there engaged kalā is the cause of knowledge-and-rest birth — thus described.

tsa-a08-v58.quick_english: Now the qualifier part which is called slight is to be known, and the effect — and it as long as she, kalā, makes apart from own self, so long this very, of enjoyment-particular interwoven with pleasure-pain-delusion-nature, of mere common, of that-guṇa-sameness-alias, of nature-principle is the emission — thus of enjoyer-enjoyed pair together dependent on kalā-principle is emission.

tsa-a08-v59.quick_english: Here, and of these by the real path, emission is sequence-barren — thus said; sequence-appearing too is, and-is-thus, too said indeed.

tsa-a08-v60.quick_english: And sequence, though of knowledge-passion and the rest varied, is seen — someone loving knows, who knowing is loved, and the rest.

tsa-a08-v61.quick_english: By that, describing differently, even in Raurava and other scriptures is uncontradicted to be deemed — but that very, become-stirred enjoyer-common, gone-to-stirring is guṇa-principle.

tsa-a08-v62.quick_english: Where pleasure is enjoyed-form-light: lucidity; pain is light-unlight-swing-natured, hence very action-formed is passion; delusion is unlight-form darkness.

tsa-a08-v64.quick_english: Thus from stirred chief comes to-be-done-arising, not from unstirred — thus.

tsa-a08-v65.quick_english: Stirring necessarily indeed in between is to be assumed — thus proved Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa-principle.

tsa-a08-v66.quick_english: And that stirring of nature from category-lord-presiding alone — otherwise fixed toward man, thus would not succeed.

tsa-a08-v67.quick_english: Then from guṇa-principle mind-principle, where man-light and object offer reflection.

tsa-a08-v68.quick_english: From mind-principle I-maker, by which in mind-mirrored object-contact turbid, in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, like silver-pride in shell.

tsa-a08-v69.quick_english: Hence indeed making-ness by this is said of it; Sāṃkhya's but that does not fit — for he does not wish self's I-feeling-nature; but we wish makership too of it.

tsa-a08-v70.quick_english: And that pure deliberation alone, non-rivalled, own-self-wonder-formed I — thus.

tsa-a08-v72.quick_english: But nature-heap of it alone is threefold, by lucidity-and-rest difference.

tsa-a08-v73.quick_english: There the lucid, from which mind and the five mind-senses — and there in mind, in the generable, endowed with all-subtle-birth power, it is the begetter.

tsa-a08-v74.quick_english: In ear, distinguished by sound-birth power — thus; up to nose, fit with smell-birth fitness — thus elemental is not fitting: since I hear and the rest following, clearly I-maker-ness; and by instrument-ness necessarily maker-part-touching-ness; otherwise, if another instrument is joined, from regress-and-rest befalling.

tsa-a08-v75.quick_english: And the maker-part is I-maker alone; by that two chief instruments: in knowing knowledge, in doing kalā — of the blind and of the lame; and from non-leaving of I-formed knowing-doing, from excelling in subtle-part, but from just the lucid I-maker, the five action-senses — I go, thus distinguished as I-maker, fit for effect-instrument; the foot-sense, its chief seat is outer, elsewhere too that is indeed — thus even of the crippled there is no going-break.

tsa-a08-v76.quick_english: And not from duty-confusion-freed alone, for the reason action is instrument-effected; and chief of goings and the rest is action-ness, not of form-and-rest grasping; of it, in Kaṇāda's system, since quality — hence necessarily to be admitted is the action-sense group.

tsa-a08-v77.quick_english: And it, the pentad, from so-much-ness of joining.

tsa-a08-v78.quick_english: Thus indeed: outside — first for giving up, or joining; for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for own-nature rest — there in order: anus, hand, foot, lap — thus.

tsa-a08-v79.quick_english: But within, in breath-seat-action joining, the speech-sense; by that, in sense-seat, in hand, which going, that too is foot-sense's alone doing — thus to be deemed; by that action-endlessness too does not bring sense-endlessness; to this extent of the rajasic clinging — thus they say.

tsa-a08-v80.quick_english: But others: from rajasic, mind — they say.

tsa-a08-v81.quick_english: Others: from lucid, mind; and from passionate, senses — thus.

tsa-a08-v82.quick_english: But from enjoyer-part-coverer, from darkness-ruled I-maker, the subtle elements, knowable-one-formed, five.

tsa-a08-v83.quick_english: Of sound-particulars, for stirring-natured, which one, unstirred-natured, pre-existent common, undistinguished-natured — that is sound-subtle.

tsa-a08-v84.quick_english: Thus up to smell too is to be said.

tsa-a08-v85.quick_english: There from stirred sound-subtle: space with space-giving business; of sound, since bearing word-superimposition-room.

tsa-a08-v86.quick_english: Sound-subtle stirred is wind; but sound of it is by ether from non-absence.

tsa-a08-v87.quick_english: Form stirred is fire; the two earlier as before.

tsa-a08-v88.quick_english: Taste stirred is waters; the earlier three as before.

tsa-a08-v89.quick_english: Smell stirred is earth; the earlier four as before.

tsa-a08-v90.quick_english: Others: by sound-touch, wind; in and-the-rest order, from five, ground — they think.

tsa-a08-v91.quick_english: Mere heap of qualities is earth; no other quality-bearer at all.

tsa-a08-v92.quick_english: And in this category-cluster, the higher-higher-qualified is pervading; the lower-qualified, pervaded.

tsa-a08-v93.quick_english: It alone is the excellence of quality: that without it, another quality does not arise; by that, earth-principle, from Śiva-principle beginning, is pervaded by water-principle — thus water by fire, and the rest, up to power-principle.

tsa-a08-v01.speaker: Teacher (tattva definition)
tsa-a08-v01.question: What is a tattva?
premises: yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ — this world-born glory-natured, wombing endless varied enjoyer-enjoyed.
tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ — what pervades as great-light-formed.
tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam — that is like the great common, Supreme-Śiva-formed.
tsa-a08-v01.inference: Paramaśiva = what pervades the whole as great light.

tsa-a08-v02.speaker: Teacher (tattva defined)
tsa-a08-v02.question: What makes a category?
premises: yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvam — what pervades only some differences: a category.
yathā pṛthivī nāma ... samastabrahmāṇḍānugatā — as earth, pervading all world-eggs from Kālāgni to Vīrabhadra.
tsa-a08-v02.inference: Partial pervasion defines tattva; earth the example.

tsa-a08-v03.speaker: Teacher (two causes)
tsa-a08-v03.question: How many cause-effect-nesses?
premises: tatra eṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo darśyate — cause-effect-ness shown.
sa ca dvividhaḥ — twofold.

tsa-a08-v04.speaker: Teacher (naming)
tsa-a08-v04.question: Which two?
premises: pāramārthikaḥ sṛṣṭeś ca — ultimate, and of emission.

tsa-a08-v05.speaker: Teacher (ultimate cause)
tsa-a08-v05.question: What is ultimate cause-effect?
premises: tatra pāramārthika etāvān kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ — this much.

yad uta kartṛsvabhāvasya svatantrasya bhagavata evaṃvidhena śivādidharāntena vapuṣā svarūpabhinnena svarūpaviśrāntena ca prathanam — the free agent-Lord's showing-forth with Śiva-to-earth body, non-different in nature, resting in own nature.
tsa-a08-v05.inference: Ultimate = Lord's self-showing as the 36-level body.

tsa-a08-v06.speaker: Teacher (constructed cause)
tsa-a08-v06.question: What is constructed?
premises: kalpitas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ parameśecchayā niyatiprāṇayā nirmitaḥ — made by the Lord's will with necessity-breath.
sa ca yāvati yadā niyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsanaṃ — fixed before-after appearing.
saty api adhike svarūpānugatam etāvaty eva — even in the more, following own nature, only so far.
tena yogīcchāto 'pi aṅkuro bījād api svapnādau ghaṭāder apīti — hence sprout from seed, yogin's wish, dream, pots and the rest.
tsa-a08-v06.inference: Constructed = willed fixed order; sprout-from-seed/wish/dream its proof.

tsa-a08-v07.speaker: Teacher (agency kept)
tsa-a08-v07.question: Does agency lapse?
premises: tatrāpi ca parameśvarasya kartṛtvānapāya — even there no loss of the Lord's agency.
iti akalpito 'pi asau pāramārthikaḥ sthita eva — thus unconstructed too, the ultimate stands.
tsa-a08-v07.inference: Agency never lapses; ultimate stands even unconstructed.

tsa-a08-v08.speaker: Teacher (wall simile)
tsa-a08-v08.question: Why is the assemblage the cause?
premises: pāramārthike hi bhittisthānīye sthite rūpe sarvam idam ullikhyamānaṃ ghaṭate na anyathā — with ultimate wall-like standing form, all this drawn fits, not otherwise.
ata eva sāmagyā eva kāruṇatvaṃ yuktam — hence by the assemblage alone caused-ness fitting.

tsa-a08-v09.speaker: Teacher (sāmagrī doctrine)
tsa-a08-v09.question: How does the total set work?
premises: sā hi samastabhāvasaṃdarbhamayī svatantrasaṃvedanamahimnā — made of all-being's weave, by free-awareness greatness.
tathā niyaratanijanijadeśakālabhāvarāśisvabhāvā — thus of fixed own place-time-thing-mass nature.
pratyekaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣpattisamaye tathābhūtā — each thing-nature completed, being thus.
tathābhūtāyā hi anyathābhāvo yathā yathā adhikībhavati — being-thus, being-otherwise as it increases.
tathā tathā kāryasyāpi vijātīyatvaṃ tāratamyena puṣyati — so the effect's other-kind-ness by degrees nourishes.
tsa-a08-v09.inference: Weave of fixed natures; deviation scales effect-difference.

option_choices.reason: fixed own place-time nature suits sāmagrī doctrine; engaged formation possible

tsa-a08-v10.speaker: Teacher (potter proof)
tsa-a08-v10.question: Who makes the pot?
premises: ity evaṃ saṃvedanasvātantryasvabhāvaḥ parameśvara eva viśvabhāvaśarīro ghaṭāder nirmātā — the free-awareness Lord, world-thing-bodied, maker of pots.
kumbhakārasaṃvidas tato 'nadhikatvāt — potter-awareness nothing beyond.
kumbhakāraśarīrasya ca bhāvarāśimadhye nikṣepāt — potter's body placed amid things.
kathaṃ kumbhakāraśarīrasya kartṛtvābhimānaḥ — how the potter-body's maker-pride?
iti ced parameśvarakṛta evāsau ghaṭādivad bhaviṣyati — if asked: Lord-made like pots it will be.
tsa-a08-v10.inference: Lord, not potter, makes; potter-pride itself Lord-made.

tsa-a08-v11.speaker: Teacher (sāmagrī seal)
tsa-a08-v11.question: What confirms makership?
premises: tasmāt sāmagrīvādo 'pi viśvaśarīrasya saṃvedanasyaiva kartṛtāyām upodbalakaḥ — assemblage-doctrine strengthens awareness-alone's makership.

tsa-a08-v12.speaker: Teacher (Meru test)
tsa-a08-v12.question: Where would no pot be?
premises: merau hi tatrasthe na bhavet tathāvidho ghaṭaḥ — on Meru, abiding there, no such pot would be.

tsa-a08-v13.speaker: Teacher (variety fits)
tsa-a08-v13.question: How do odd births fit?
premises: evaṃ kalpite 'smin kāryatve śāstreṣu tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ prati yat bahuprakāratvaṃ tad api saṃgataṃ — in constructed caused-ness, the many-typed-ness fits.
gomayāt kīṭāt yogīcchāto mantrād auṣadhāt vṛścikodayavat — from dung worms, yogin's wish, mantra, herbs, like scorpion-arising.

tsa-a08-v14.speaker: Teacher (own system)
tsa-a08-v14.question: What now?
premises: tatra nijatantradṛśā taṃ kalpitaṃ darśayāmaḥ — by own-system view we show the constructed.

tsa-a08-v15.speaker: Teacher (five powers)
tsa-a08-v15.question: How does the Lord stand fivefold?
premises: tatra parameśvaraḥ pañcabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ nirbhara iti uktam — full with five powers.
sa svātantryāt śaktiṃ tāṃ tāṃ mukhyatayā prakaṭayan pañcadhā tiṣṭhati — manifesting power after power chiefly, stands fivefold.
tsa-a08-v15.inference: Five powers, fivefold stand by freedom.

tsa-a08-v16.speaker: Teacher (five principles)
tsa-a08-v16.question: How do the principles divide?
premises: citprādhānye śivatattvam — awareness-led: Śiva.
ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam — bliss-led: power.
icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam — will-led: Sadāśiva.
icchāyā hi jñānakriyayoḥ sāmyarūpābhyupagamātmakatvāt — will is even-acceptance of knowing-doing.
jñānaśaktipradhānye īśvaratattvam — knowledge-led: Īśvara.
kriyāśaktipradhānye vidyātattvam — action-led: knowledge (-vidyā).
tsa-a08-v16.inference: Five principles by power-primacy; will as even-acceptance.

tsa-a08-v17.speaker: Teacher (pure path)
tsa-a08-v17.question: What is the pure path?
premises: atra ca tattveśvarāḥ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvarānantāḥ — lords Śiva through Ananta.
brahmeva nivṛttau — like Brahmā in withdrawal.
eṣāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ viśeṣā anugativiṣayāḥ pañca — five particulars with pervasion for object.
tadyathā śāmbhavāḥ śāktā mantramaheśvarā mantreśvarā mantrāḥ iti śuddhādhvā — Śāmbhavas to Mantras: pure path.
tsa-a08-v17.inference: Lords and five beings: the pure path.

tsa-a08-v18.speaker: Teacher (impure path)
tsa-a08-v18.question: Who makes the impure path?
premises: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā — so far directly Śiva maker.
aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati — impure path Aghoreśa-Ananta emits.
īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham — by Lord's will, for wavered atoms' enjoyment-perfection.
tsa-a08-v18.inference: Aghoreśa-Ananta emits the impure path for craving atoms.

tsa-a08-v19.speaker: Teacher (craving)
tsa-a08-v19.question: Is craving impurity?
premises: tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti — waverer, incomplete, other-natured throbbing, mere longing, future fitness for bounding.
na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram — not man's impurity nor another category.
tsa-a08-v19.inference: Craving = mere longing, not impurity, no new category.

tsa-a08-v20.speaker: Teacher (passion)
tsa-a08-v20.question: What is passion?
premises: rāgatattvaṃ tu karmāvacchinno 'bhilāṣaḥ — passion-principle is action-bounded longing.

tsa-a08-v21.speaker: Teacher (action)
tsa-a08-v21.question: What is action?
premises: karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ — action is mere action there; mind-nature is passion.
karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate — varied by action-difference; distinction to be told.
tsa-a08-v21.inference: Action mere; passion mind-nature; distinction deferred.

tsa-a08-v22.speaker: Teacher (impurity defined)
tsa-a08-v22.question: What is impurity?
premises: so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ — this impurity: from the Lord's self-veiling wish.
nānyat kiṃcid vastv api — nothing else at all a thing.
ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt — and by that Lord-wish-nature alone is earth-and-rest's thingness.
tsa-a08-v22.inference: Impurity = Lord's self-veiling wish; nothing else; things real only thus.

tsa-a08-v23.speaker: Teacher (kevalins)
tsa-a08-v23.question: How do kevalins differ?
premises: sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati — existing in knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction: does not fatten its effect-action.

pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam — but yawning in dissolution-kevalin: impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-variety-enjoyment.
tsa-a08-v23.inference: Knowledge-kevalin starves action; dissolution-kevalin fuels it.

tsa-a08-v24.speaker: Teacher (Aghoreśa emits)
tsa-a08-v24.question: Why does Aghoreśa emit?
premises: tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati — for enjoyment-pierced atoms' perfection, glorious Aghoreśa emits.
iti yuktam uktam — fittingly said.
malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva — impurity's stirring by Lord-wish-force alone.
jaḍasya svataḥ kutracid api asāmarthyāt — of the inert by itself, anywhere, inability.
tsa-a08-v24.inference: Enjoyment-need + inert inability ground Aghoreśa's emission.

tsa-a08-v25.speaker: Teacher (atom and Māyā)
tsa-a08-v25.question: What is the atom, what Māyā?
premises: aṇur nāma kila cidacidrūpāvabhāsa eva — atom: mere conscious-unconscious shining.
tasya cidrūpam aiśvaryam eva — conscious form is lordliness.
acidrūpataiva malaḥ — unconscious-formedness alone impurity.
tasya ca sṛjataḥ parameśvarecchāmayaṃ — of it emitting, by Lord-wish-made.

tata eva ca nityaṃ srakṣyamāṇavastugatasya rūpasya jaḍatayābhāsayiṣyamāṇatvāj jaḍaṃ sakalakāryavyāpanādirūpatvāc ca vyāpakaṃ māyākhyaṃ tattvam upādānakāraṇaṃ — thence always: inert, all-effect-pervading Māyā-principle as material cause.
tadavabhāsakāriṇī ca parameśvarasya māyā nāma śaktis tato 'nyaiva — showing it forth: the Lord's Māyā-power, quite other.
tsa-a08-v25.inference: Atom = shining; impurity = unconscious side; Māyā-principle inert-pervading material cause; Māyā-power distinct.

tsa-a08-v26.speaker: Teacher (two-formedness)
tsa-a08-v26.question: What of kalā to earth?
premises: evaṃ kalāditattvānāṃ dharāntānām api dvairūpyaṃ nirūpyam — kalā-to-earth principles too two-formedness to be described.

tsa-a08-v27.speaker: Teacher (proof cited)
tsa-a08-v27.question: What proof?
premises: atra ca dvairūpye pramāṇam apy āhur abhinavaguptaguravaḥ — here too proof have said Abhinavagupta's gurus.

tsa-a08-v28.speaker: Teacher (proof verse)
tsa-a08-v28.question: What shines outside?
premises: yad saṃkalpe bhāti tat pṛthagbhūtaṃ bahir api asti sphuṭena vapuṣā ghaṭa iva — what shines in resolve exists outside too, with clear form, like a pot.

tsa-a08-v29.speaker: Teacher (rule)
tsa-a08-v29.question: What rule?
premises: tathā ca māyākalādikhapuṣpāder api eṣaiva vartanī iti kevalānvayī hetuḥ — Māyā-kalā-sky-flowers too this very course: purely affirmative reason.

tsa-a08-v30.speaker: Teacher (siddhas)
tsa-a08-v30.question: Who is perfected?
premises: anena ca māyākalāprakṛtibuddhyādiviṣayaṃ sākṣātkārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ye bhajante te 'pi siddhāḥ siddhā eva — who enjoy direct-realization knowing with Māyā-kalā-nature-mind and the rest as object: perfected indeed.

tsa-a08-v31.speaker: Teacher (world-birth)
tsa-a08-v31.question: Whence world-birth?
premises: evaṃ sthite māyātattvāt viśvaprasavaḥ — thus standing, from Māyā-principle world-birth.

tsa-a08-v32.speaker: Teacher (order debate)
tsa-a08-v32.question: Sequential or not?
premises: sa ca yady api akramam eva tathāpi uktadṛśā kramo 'vabhāsate — though non-sequential, by the stated view sequence appears.

tsa-a08-v33.speaker: Teacher (kalā groups)
tsa-a08-v33.question: How are kalā groups divided?
premises: so 'py ucyate tatra pratyātma kalādivargo bhinnaḥ — even that is told: per self the kalā-group divided.

tsa-a08-v34.speaker: Teacher (pure group)
tsa-a08-v34.question: Which group is pure?
premises: tatkāryasya kartṛtvopodbalanādeḥ pratyātmabhedena upalambhāt — from effect-makership-strengthening found by self-difference.
sa tu vargaḥ kadācit ekībhavet api īśvarecchayā sāmājikātmanām iva — but the group may become one by the Lord's wish, like social selves.

tatra sarvo 'yaṃ kalādivargaḥ śuddho yaḥ parameśvaraviṣayatayā tatsvarūpalābhānuguṇanijakāryakārī saṃsārapratidvaṃdvitvāt — all this kalā-group pure which, Lord-objected, does own work fit for gaining its nature, from world-opposition.
tsa-a08-v34.inference: Pure = Lord-objected work-doers; oneness possible by wish.

tsa-a08-v35.speaker: Teacher (how pure)
tsa-a08-v35.question: How become pure?
premises: sa ca parameśvaraśaktipātavaśāt tathā bhavati — by Lord-power-descent sway it becomes thus.
iti vakṣyāmas tatprakāśane — to be told in its showing.

tsa-a08-v36.speaker: Teacher (impure)
tsa-a08-v36.question: What is impure?
premises: aśuddhas tu tadviparītaḥ — impure is opposite of that.

tsa-a08-v37.speaker: Teacher (kalā born)
tsa-a08-v37.question: How is kalā born?
premises: tatra māyātaḥ kalā jātā — from Māyā kalā born.
yā suptasthānīyam aṇuṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvena yunakti — which yokes the sleeping atom with slight makership.
sā ca ucchūnateva saṃsārabījasya — and as if swelling, of transmigration-seed.
māyāṇvor ubhayoḥ saṃyogāt utpannāpi māyāṃ vikaroti na avikāryam aṇum — arisen from Māyā-atom union, deforms Māyā, not the undeformable atom.
iti māyākāryatvam asyāḥ — thus her Māyā-effect-ness.
tsa-a08-v37.inference: Kalā yokes sleepers, swells, deforms Māyā not atoms.

tsa-a08-v38.speaker: Teacher (man-kalā)
tsa-a08-v38.question: What of man and kalā?
premises: evam anyonyaśleṣāt alakṣaṇīyāntaratvaṃ puṃskalayoḥ — from mutual clinging, indistinguishable inwardness of man and kalā.

tsa-a08-v39.speaker: Teacher (discriminations)
tsa-a08-v39.question: What discriminations free?
premises: māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati — Māyā-womb officers, by some lord's grace, when all action ends: Māyā-man discrimination.
yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste — by which above Māyā sits the knowledge-kevalin.
na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā — never below Māyā kalā-man discrimination.
yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati — by which one stands above kalā.
tsa-a08-v39.inference: Grace-ending-action → Māyā-man then kalā-man discriminations, stationed above.

tsa-a08-v40.speaker: Teacher (nature-man)
tsa-a08-v40.question: What of nature-man?
premises: prakṛtipuruṣaviveko vā yena pradhānādho na saṃsaret — nature-man discrimination, by which below the chief one does not transmigrate.

tsa-a08-v41.speaker: Teacher (impurity-man)
tsa-a08-v41.question: What of impurity-man?
premises: malapuruṣaviveke tu śivasamānatvam — in impurity-man discrimination: Śiva-likeness.

tsa-a08-v42.speaker: Teacher (fullness)
tsa-a08-v42.question: What of fullness?
premises: puruṣapūrṇatādṛṣṭau tu śivatvam eva — when man's fullness is seen: Śiva-ness alone.

tsa-a08-v43.speaker: Teacher (kalā alone)
tsa-a08-v43.question: Does kalā alone give?
premises: evaṃ kalātattvam eva kiṃcitkartṛtvdāyi na ca — kalā-principle alone gives slight makership, not... (completed u44).
tsa-a08-v43.inference: Kalā gives slight makership — sentence completes u44.

tsa-a08-v44.speaker: Teacher (not the unknowing's)
tsa-a08-v44.question: Whose makership?
premises: kartṛtvam ajñasya iti — makership of the unknowing: thus.
tsa-a08-v44.inference: Completes: slight makership, not the unknowing's full makership.

tsa-a08-v45.speaker: Teacher (impure knowledge)
tsa-a08-v45.question: What is impure knowledge?
premises: kiṃcijjñatvadāyiny aśuddhavidyā kalāto jātā — slight-knowing-giving impure knowledge born from kalā.
sā ca vidyā buddhiṃ paśyati — it sees mind.
tadgatāṃś ca sukhādīn vivekena gṛhṇāti — grasps its parts, pleasures and the rest, with discrimination.
tsa-a08-v45.inference: Impure knowledge from kalā: sees mind, grasps parts discriminately.

tsa-a08-v46.speaker: Teacher (mind's limit)
tsa-a08-v46.question: What limits mind?
premises: buddher guṇasaṃkīrṇākārāyā vivekena grahītum asāmarthyāt — of quality-confused mind, inability to grasp with discrimination.

tsa-a08-v47.speaker: Teacher (discerned)
tsa-a08-v47.question: How discerned?
premises: tasmāt buddhipratibimbito bhāvo vidyayā vivicyate — hence the mind-mirrored being is discerned by knowledge.

tsa-a08-v48.speaker: Teacher (where passion acts)
tsa-a08-v48.question: Where does passion act?
premises: kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ kiṃcidbhāgasiddhaye kvacid eva kartṛtvam ity atra arthe paryavasyati — slight makership for some-part perfection: makership somewhere alone — in this sense it comes down.
kvacid eva ca ity atra bhāge rāgatattvasya vyāpāraḥ — somewhere too in this part is passion-principle's business.
tsa-a08-v48.inference: Slight makership somewhere; passion's business in the part.

tsa-a08-v49.speaker: Teacher (dispassion)
tsa-a08-v49.question: Is it from dispassion?
premises: na ca avairāgyakṛtaṃ tat — not from non-dispassion made.
avairāgyasyāpy arakradarśanāt — seeing non-attachment even of the non-dispassionate.
tsa-a08-v49.inference: Not from dispassion; non-attached even the dispassionate.

tsa-a08-v50.speaker: Teacher (attachment seen)
tsa-a08-v50.question: Where is attachment seen?
premises: vairāgye dharmādāv api raktir dṛśyate — in dispassion, even in duty and the rest, attachment is seen.

tsa-a08-v51.speaker: Teacher (sated)
tsa-a08-v51.question: What of the sated?
premises: tṛptasya ca annādau avairāgyābhāve 'pi antaḥstharāgānapāyāt — of the sated in food and the rest, though non-dispassion absent, from unremoved inner passion.

tsa-a08-v52.speaker: Teacher (contingency)
tsa-a08-v52.question: Why contingency?
premises: tena vinā punar avairāgyānutpattiprasaṅgāt — without that, again non-dispassion-non-arising contingency.

tsa-a08-v53.speaker: Teacher (necessity's business)
tsa-a08-v53.question: What is necessity's business?
premises: kālaś ca kāryaṃ kalayaṃs tadavacchinnaṃ kartṛtvam api kalayati — time reckoning effect reckons even bounded makership.
tulye kvacittve asmin eva kartṛtvam ity atrārthe niyater vyāpāraḥ — in the like some-where-ness, this alone makership: in this sense necessity's business.
tsa-a08-v53.inference: Time reckons bounded makership; necessity's business in this sense.

tsa-a08-v54.speaker: Teacher (beast defined)
tsa-a08-v54.question: What is the beast?
premises: kāryakāraṇabhāve 'pi asyā eva vyāpāraḥ — in cause-effect-ness too hers alone is the business.
tena kalāta eva etac catuṣkaṃ jātam — hence from kalā alone this fourfold born.

idam eva kiṃcid adhunā jānan abhiṣvaktaḥ karomi ity evaṃrūpā saṃvid dehapuryaṣṭakādigatā paśur ity ucyate — this very, slightly now knowing, clinging, I-do: thus-formed awareness gone to body-city-eight and the rest is called beast.
tsa-a08-v54.inference: Her business; kalā-born fourfold; clinging I-do awareness = beast.

tsa-a08-v55.speaker: Teacher (six sheaths)
tsa-a08-v55.question: What are the six?
premises: tad idaṃ māyādiṣaṭkaṃ kañcukaṣaṭkam ucyate — this Māyā-and-rest six is called six sheaths.

tsa-a08-v56.speaker: Teacher (why sheaths)
tsa-a08-v56.question: Why sheaths?
premises: saṃvido māyayā apahastitatvena kalādīnām uparipātināṃ kañcukavat avasthānāt — awareness by Māyā set aside; kalā and the rest falling above stand like sheaths.
tsa-a08-v56.inference: Set-aside awareness; above-falling kalā stands sheath-like.

tsa-a08-v57.speaker: Teacher (kalā's issue)
tsa-a08-v57.question: What issues from kalā?
premises: evaṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ yat māyākāryaṃ — slight makership which is Māyā-effect.
tatra kiṃcit tv aviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣyaṃ — there the slight, but, undistinguished which makership to be qualified.
tatra vyāpriyamāṇā kalā vidyādiprasavahetuḥ iti nirūpitam — there engaged kalā is the cause of knowledge-and-rest birth: described.

option_choices.reason: tu adversative fits slight-yet-undistinguished turn; tva fragment ungrammatical

tsa-a08-v58.speaker: Teacher (enjoyed-common)
tsa-a08-v58.question: What is the enjoyed-common?
premises: idānīṃ viśeṣaṇabhāgo yaḥ kiṃcid ity ukto jñeyaḥ kāryaś ca — now the qualifier part called slight is to be known, and the effect.
taṃ yāvat sā kalā svātmanaḥ pṛthak kurute — as long as she, kalā, makes apart from own self.

tāvad eṣa eva sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhogyaviśeṣānusyūtasya sāmānyamātrasya tadguṇasāmyāparanāmnaḥ prakṛtitattvasya sargaḥ — so long this very, of enjoyment-particular interwoven with pleasure-pain-delusion-nature, of mere common, of that-guṇa-sameness-alias, of nature-principle is the emission.
iti bhoktṛbhogyayugalasya samam eva kalātattvāyattā sṛṣṭiḥ — thus enjoyer-enjoyed pair together dependent on kalā-principle is emission.
tsa-a08-v58.inference: Qualifier part; kalā's apart-making emits the enjoyed-common; pair-emission kalā-dependent.

tsa-a08-v59.speaker: Teacher (sequence debate)
tsa-a08-v59.question: Sequential or not?
premises: atra caiṣāṃ vāstavena pathā kramavandhyaiva sṛṣṭir ity uktaṃ — here, and by the real path, emission is sequence-barren: said.
kramāvabhāso 'pi cāstīty api uktam eva — sequence-appearing too is, and-is-thus, too said indeed.
tsa-a08-v59.inference: Real path barren, appearance sequential: both said.

tsa-a08-v60.speaker: Teacher (varied order)
tsa-a08-v60.question: Is order varied?
premises: kramaś ca vidyārāgādīnām vicitro 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ — sequence of knowledge-passion and the rest though varied is seen.
kaścid rajyan vetti — someone loving knows.
ko 'pi vidan rajyate ityādi — who knowing is loved, and the rest.
tsa-a08-v60.inference: Loving-knowing varies in order: both directions seen.

tsa-a08-v61.speaker: Teacher (scriptural variety)
tsa-a08-v61.question: Does variety contradict?
premises: tena bhinnakramanirūpaṇam api rauravādiṣu śāstreṣv aviruddhaṃ mantavyaṃ — different-order description even in Raurava and the rest deemed uncontradicted.
tad eva tu bhogyasāmānyaṃ prakṣobhagataṃ guṇatattvam — but that very, become-stirred enjoyed-common: guṇa-principle.
tsa-a08-v61.inference: Varied order uncontradicted; stirred enjoyed-common = guṇa.

tsa-a08-v62.speaker: Teacher (guṇa natures)
tsa-a08-v62.question: What are the guṇa natures?
premises: yatra sukhaṃ bhogyarūpaprakāśaḥ sattvam — where pleasure, enjoyed-form-light: lucidity.
duḥkhaṃ prakāśāprakāśāndolanātmakam ata eva kriyārūpaṃ rajaḥ — pain light-unlight-swing-natured, hence action-formed passion.
mohaḥ prakāśābhāvarūpas tamaḥ — delusion unlight-formed darkness.

tsa-a08-v63.speaker: Teacher (triad)
tsa-a08-v63.question: What is the triad?
premises: tritayam api etad bhogyarūpam — triad too, this enjoyed-formed.

tsa-a08-v64.speaker: Teacher (stirring needed)
tsa-a08-v64.question: Must the chief stir?
premises: evaṃ kṣubdhāt pradhānāt kartavyāntarodayaḥ na akṣubdhād iti — from stirred chief, to-be-done-arising; not from unstirred.

tsa-a08-v65.speaker: Teacher (proof needed)
tsa-a08-v65.question: Why assume stirring?
premises: kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle 'bhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyaparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam — stirring necessarily indeed in between to be assumed: thus proved Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa-principle.
tsa-a08-v65.inference: Stirring must be assumed between; Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa.

tsa-a08-v66.speaker: Teacher (presiding needed)
tsa-a08-v66.question: Why presiding?
premises: sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva — and that stirring from category-lord-presiding alone.
anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet — otherwise toward fixed man, thus would not succeed.

tsa-a08-v67.speaker: Teacher (mind born)
tsa-a08-v67.question: How is mind born?
premises: tato guṇatattvāt buddhitattvaṃ yatra puṃprakāśo viṣayaś ca pratibimbam arpayataḥ — then from guṇa-principle mind-principle, where man-light and object offer reflection.
tsa-a08-v67.inference: Guṇa to mind; man-light and object reflect.

tsa-a08-v68.speaker: Teacher (I-maker born)
tsa-a08-v68.question: How is I-maker born?
premises: buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāshi 'nātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat — from mind-principle I-maker, by which in mind-mirrored object-contact turbid, in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, like silver-pride in shell.
tsa-a08-v68.inference: Mind-mirror turbid contact breeds self-pride; shell-silver simile.

tsa-a08-v69.speaker: Teacher (Sāṃkhya refused)
tsa-a08-v69.question: Why not Sāṃkhya?
premises: ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ — hence making-ness by this of it is said.
sāṃkhyasya tu tat na yujyate — Sāṃkhya's that does not fit.
sa hi na ātmano 'haṃvimarśamayatām icchati — for he does not wish self's I-feeling-nature.
vayaṃ tu kartṛtvam api tasya icchāmaḥ — but we wish makership too of it.
tsa-a08-v69.inference: We keep I-feeling and makership; Sāṃkhya fits neither.

tsa-a08-v70.speaker: Teacher (pure I)
tsa-a08-v70.question: What is pure I?
premises: tac ca śuddhaṃ vimarśa eva apratiyogi svātmacamatkārarūpo 'ham iti — and that pure deliberation alone, non-rivalled, own-self-wonder-formed I: thus.

tsa-a08-v71.speaker: Teacher (instrument heap)
tsa-a08-v71.question: What is the instrument heap?
premises: eṣo 'sya ahaṃkārasya karaṇaskandhaḥ — this is of it, of I-maker: instrument-heap.

tsa-a08-v72.speaker: Teacher (nature heap)
tsa-a08-v72.question: What is the nature heap?
premises: prakṛtiskandhas tu tasyaiva trividhaḥ sattvādibhedāt — nature-heap of it alone threefold, by lucidity-and-rest difference.

tsa-a08-v73.speaker: Teacher (lucid creation)
tsa-a08-v73.question: What does the lucid create?
premises: tatra sāttviko yasmāt manaś ca buddhīndriyapañcakaṃ ca — there the lucid, from which mind and five mind-senses.
tatra manasi janye sarvatanmātrajanasaṃsāmarthyayuktaḥ sa janakaḥ — there in generable mind, endowed with all-subtle-birth power: it the begetter.
tsa-a08-v73.inference: Lucid mind begets; all-subtle-birth power in generable mind.

tsa-a08-v74.speaker: Teacher (sense proof)
tsa-a08-v74.question: How are senses proved?
premises: śrotre tu śabdajananasāmarthyaviśiṣṭa iti — in ear, distinguished by sound-birth power: thus.
yāvad ghrāṇe gandhajananayogyatāyukta iti — up to nose, fit with smell-birth fitness: thus.
bhautikam api na yuktam — elemental too not fitting.
ahaṃ śṛṇomi ityādyanugamāc ca sphuṭam āhaṃkārikatvam — from I-hear and the rest following, clearly I-maker-ness.
karaṇatvena ca avaśyaṃ kartraṃśasparśitvam — and by instrument-ness necessarily maker-part-touching.
anyathā karaṇāntarayojanāyām anavasthādyāpātāt — otherwise, if another instrument is joined, from regress-and-rest befalling.
tsa-a08-v74.inference: Sense-powers prove I-maker-ness; regress bars extra instruments.

tsa-a08-v75.speaker: Teacher (two chief instruments)
tsa-a08-v75.question: Which two are chief?
premises: kartraṃśaś ca ahaṃkāra eva — maker-part is I-maker alone.
tena mukhye karaṇe dve — by that two chief instruments.
puṃsaḥ jñāne vidyā kriyāyāṃ kalā — of man, in knowing knowledge, in doing kalā.
andhasya paṅgoś ca ahaṃtārūpajñānakriyānapagamāt — of blind and lame, from non-leaving of I-formed knowing-doing.
udriktatanmātrabhāgaviśiṣṭāt tu sāttvikād eva ahaṃkārāt karmendriyapañcakam — but from just the lucid I-maker excelling in subtle-part: five action-senses.
ahaṃ gacchāmi ity ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭaḥ — I go: distinguished as I-maker.
kāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ — fit for effect-instrument.
pādendriyaṃ tasya mukhyādhiṣṭhānaṃ bāhyam — foot-sense: its chief seat outer.
anyatrāpi tad asty eva — elsewhere too that is indeed.
iti rugṇasyāpi na gativicchedaḥ — thus even of the crippled no going-break.
tsa-a08-v75.inference: Knowledge/kalā chief; blind-lame I-ness; five action-senses; foot outer-seated; no break for crippled.

tsa-a08-v76.speaker: Teacher (action senses proved)
tsa-a08-v76.question: Why admit action-senses?
premises: na ca kartavyasāṃkaryamuktād eva hetoḥ kriyā karaṇakāryā mukhyaṃ ca — and not from duty-confusion-freed alone the reason: action is instrument-effected, chief.
ca gamanādīnāṃ kriyātvaṃ na rūpādyupalambhasya — and of goings and the rest is action-ness, not of form-and-rest grasping.
tasya kāṇādatantre guṇatvāt — of it, in Kaṇāda's system, since quality.
tasmāt avaśyābhyupeyaḥ karmendriyavargaḥ — hence necessarily to be admitted is the action-sense group.
tsa-a08-v76.inference: Going is action not grasping; Kaṇāda agrees; group admitted.

tsa-a08-v77.speaker: Teacher (pentad measure)
tsa-a08-v77.question: How many?
premises: sa ca pañcakaḥ anusaṃdhes tāvattvāt — and it, the pentad, from so-much-ness of joining.

tsa-a08-v78.speaker: Teacher (five openings)
tsa-a08-v78.question: Which five?
premises: tathā hi bahis tāvat tyāgāya vā anusaṃdhiḥ ādānāya vā dvayāya vā ubhayarahitatvena svarūpaviśrāntaye vā — thus outside: first for giving up, or joining; for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for own-nature rest.
tatra krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda upastha iti — there in order: anus, hand, foot, lap.

tsa-a08-v79.speaker: Teacher (speech sense)
tsa-a08-v79.question: What of speech?
premises: antaḥ prāṇāśrayakarmānusaṃdhes tu vāgindriyam — within, in breath-seat-action joining: speech-sense.
tena indriyādhiṣṭhāne haste yat gamanaṃ tad api pādendriyasyaiva karma iti mantavyam — by that, in sense-seat, in hand, whatever going: that too is foot-sense's alone doing.
iti mantavyam tena karmānantyam api na indriyānantyam āvahet — thus to be deemed; by that action-endlessness too does not bring sense-endlessness.
iyati rājasasya upaśleṣakatvam ity āhuḥ — to this extent the rajasic's clinging: they say.
tsa-a08-v79.inference: Speech within; hand-going is foot's doing; no sense-infinity.

tsa-a08-v80.speaker: Teacher (others' view)
tsa-a08-v80.question: What do others say?
premises: anye tu rājasān mana ity āhuḥ — others: from rajasic, mind — they say.

tsa-a08-v81.speaker: Teacher (others' view)
tsa-a08-v81.question: What else?
premises: anye tu sāttvikāt mano rājasāc ca indriyāṇi iti — others: from lucid, mind; and from passionate, senses.

tsa-a08-v82.speaker: Teacher (tamasic issue)
tsa-a08-v82.question: What from tamasic I?
premises: bhoktraṃśāc chādakāt tu tamaḥpradhānāhaṃkārāt tanmātrāṇi vedyaikarūpāṇi pañca — from enjoyer-part-coverer, from darkness-ruled I-maker: the subtle elements, knowable-one-formed, five.
tsa-a08-v82.inference: Darkness-ruled I yields five knowable-formed subtle elements.

tsa-a08-v83.speaker: Teacher (sound-subtle)
tsa-a08-v83.question: What is sound-subtle?
premises: śabdaviśeṣāṇāṃ hi kṣobhātmanāṃ yad ekam akṣobhātmakaṃ prāgbhāvi sāmānyam aviśeṣātmakaṃ tat śabdatanmātram — of sound-particulars stirring-natured, which one unstirred-natured, pre-existent, common, undistinguished: that is sound-subtle.

tsa-a08-v84.speaker: Teacher (rest likewise)
tsa-a08-v84.question: And the rest?
premises: evaṃ gandhānte 'pi vācyam — thus up to smell too to be said.

tsa-a08-v85.speaker: Teacher (ether)
tsa-a08-v85.question: How is ether born?
premises: tatra śabdatanmātrāt kṣubhitāt avakāśadānavyāpāraṃ nabhaḥ — from stirred sound-subtle: space-giving-business ether.
śabdasya vācyādhyāsāvakāśasahatvāt — since sound bears word-superimposition-room.

tsa-a08-v86.speaker: Teacher (wind)
tsa-a08-v86.question: How is wind born?
premises: śabdatanmātraṃ kṣubhitaṃ vāyuḥ — sound-subtle stirred is wind.
śabdas tu asya nabhasā virahābhāvāt — but sound of it is by ether from non-absence.
tsa-a08-v86.inference: Sound-subtle stirred = wind; sound needs ether.

tsa-a08-v87.speaker: Teacher (fire)
tsa-a08-v87.question: How fire?
premises: rūpaṃ kṣubhitaṃ tejaḥ — form stirred is fire.
pūrvaguṇau tu pūrvavat — the two earlier as before.
tsa-a08-v87.inference: Stirred form = fire with two earlier.

tsa-a08-v88.speaker: Teacher (waters)
tsa-a08-v88.question: How waters?
premises: rasaḥ kṣubhito āpaḥ — taste stirred is waters.
pūrve trayaḥ pūrvavat — the earlier three as before.
tsa-a08-v88.inference: Stirred taste = waters with three earlier.

tsa-a08-v89.speaker: Teacher (earth)
tsa-a08-v89.question: How earth?
premises: gandhaḥ kṣubhito dharā — smell stirred is earth.
pūrve catvāraḥ pūrvavat — the earlier four as before.
tsa-a08-v89.inference: Stirred smell = earth with four earlier.

tsa-a08-v90.speaker: Teacher (others' order)
tsa-a08-v90.question: What do others say?
premises: anye śabdasparśābhyāṃ vāyuḥ ityādikrameṇa pañcabhyo dharaṇī iti manyante — others: from sound-touch wind, in and-the-rest order, from five ground — they think.
tsa-a08-v90.inference: Others derive ground from five via sound-touch.

tsa-a08-v91.speaker: Teacher (earth defined)
tsa-a08-v91.question: What is earth?
premises: guṇasamudāyamātraṃ ca pṛthivī — mere heap of qualities is earth.
nānyo guṇī kaścit — no other quality-bearer at all.
tsa-a08-v91.inference: Earth = heap of qualities, no bearer.

tsa-a08-v92.speaker: Teacher (pervading)
tsa-a08-v92.question: What pervades?
premises: asmiṃś ca tattvakalāpe ūrdhvordhvaguṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ nikṛṣṭaguṇaṃ tu vyāpyam — and in this category-cluster: higher-higher-qualified is pervading; lower-qualified, pervaded.

tsa-a08-v93.speaker: Teacher (pervasion proved)
tsa-a08-v93.question: How is pervasion proved?
premises: sa eva guṇasya utkarṣo yat tena vinā guṇāntaraṃ na upapadyate — it alone is excellence of quality: that without it, another quality does not arise.
tena pṛthivītattvaṃ śivatattvāt prabhṛti jalatattvena vyāptam — hence earth-principle from Śiva-principle beginning is pervaded by water-principle.
evaṃ jalaṃ tejasā ityādi yāvac chaktitattvam — thus water by fire, and the rest, up to power-principle.
tsa-a08-v93.inference: Excellence needs lower; earth pervaded from Śiva down to water, up to power.

tsa-a08-v01.plain_english: Which this world-born glory-natured, said to womb endless varied enjoyer-enjoyed — there whatever pervades as great-light-formed, that is like the great common, Supreme-Śiva-formed.
tsa-a08-v01.sanskrit_cite: yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam

tsa-a08-v02.plain_english: But whatever form pervading only some differences, that is a category — as earth called of glow-hardness-bulk-and-rest form, pervading all world-eggs ruled by world-lords from Kālāgni to Vīrabhadra.
tsa-a08-v02.sanskrit_cite: yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvaṃ yathā pṛthivī nāma dyutikāṭhinyasthaulyādirūpā kālāgniprabhṛtivīrabhadrāntabhuvaneśādhiṣṭhitasamastabrahmāṇḍānugatā

tsa-a08-v03.plain_english: There of these categories cause-effect-ness is shown; and it is twofold.
tsa-a08-v03.sanskrit_cite: tatra eṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo darśyate sa ca dvividhaḥ

tsa-a08-v05.plain_english: There the ultimate cause-effect-ness is this much: namely, of the agent-natured, free Lord, with such from-Śiva-to-earth-ended body, non-different in nature and resting in own nature — the showing-forth.
tsa-a08-v05.sanskrit_cite: tatra pāramārthika etāvān kāryakāraṇabhāvo yad uta kartṛsvabhāvasya svatantrasya bhagavata evaṃvidhena śivādidharāntena vapuṣā svarūpabhinnena svarūpaviśrāntena ca prathanam

tsa-a08-v06.plain_english: But the constructed cause-effect-ness, made by the Lord's will with necessity-breath: and as long as, when fixed before-after appearing, being even in the more, following own nature, only so far — by that from yogin's wish too, sprout from seed too, in dream and the rest, from pots and the rest, even thus.
tsa-a08-v06.sanskrit_cite: kalpitas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ parameśecchayā niyatiprāṇayā nirmitaḥ sa ca yāvati yadā niyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsanaṃ saty api adhike svarūpānugatam etāvaty eva tena yogīcchāto 'pi aṅkuro bījād api svapnādau ghaṭāder apīti

tsa-a08-v07.plain_english: And there too, of the Supreme Lord non-loss of agency — thus even unconstructed, that ultimate stands firm.
tsa-a08-v07.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi ca parameśvarasya kartṛtvānapāya iti akalpito 'pi asau pāramārthikaḥ sthita eva

tsa-a08-v08.plain_english: For with the ultimate wall-like standing form, all this drawn is fitting, not otherwise. Hence by the assemblage alone is caused-ness fitting.
tsa-a08-v08.sanskrit_cite: pāramārthike hi bhittisthānīye sthite rūpe sarvam idam ullikhyamānaṃ ghaṭate na anyathā ata eva sāmagryā eva kāruṇatvaṃ yuktam

tsa-a08-v09.plain_english: For it, made of the weave of all beings, by free-awareness greatness, thus of fixed own place-time-thing-mass nature — each thing-nature completed, being thus; of being-thus, being-otherwise — as it increases, so the effect's other-kind-ness by degrees nourishes.
tsa-a08-v09.sanskrit_cite: sā hi samastabhāvasaṃdarbhamayī svatantrasaṃvedanamahimnā tathā niyatanijanijadeśakālabhāvarāśisvabhāvā pratyekaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣpattisamaye tathābhūtā tathābhūtāyā hi anyathābhāvo yathā yathā adhikībhavati tathā tathā kāryasyāpi vijātīyatvaṃ tāratamyena puṣyati

tsa-a08-v10.plain_english: Thus the free-awareness-natured Supreme Lord alone, world-thing-bodied, is the maker of pots and the rest — since potter-awareness, from not being greater, and the potter's body placed amid the thing-mass — how is the potter-body's maker-pride? Thus — if Lord-made even that will be, like pots and the rest.
tsa-a08-v10.sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvedanasvātantryasvabhāvaḥ parameśvara eva viśvabhāvaśarīro ghaṭāder nirmātā kumbhakārasaṃvidas tato 'nadhikatvāt kumbhakāraśarīrasya ca bhāvarāśimadhye nikṣepāt kathaṃ kumbhakāraśarīrasya kartṛtvābhimānaḥ iti cet parameśvarakṛta evāsau ghaṭādivat bhaviṣyati

tsa-a08-v11.plain_english: Hence the assemblage-doctrine too strengthens makership of awareness alone, the world-bodied.
tsa-a08-v11.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sāmagrīvādo 'pi viśvaśarīrasya saṃvedanasyaiva kartṛtāyām upodbalakaḥ

tsa-a08-v12.plain_english: For a pot such as would be there on Meru would not be.
tsa-a08-v12.sanskrit_cite: merau hi tatrasthe na bhavet tathāvidho ghaṭaḥ

tsa-a08-v13.plain_english: Thus in the constructed caused-ness, the many-typed-ness toward categories' cause-effect-ness in scriptures — that too fits — from dung, worms, from yogin's wish, from mantra, from herbs: like scorpion-arising.
tsa-a08-v13.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalpite 'smin kāryatve śāstreṣu tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ prati yat bahuprakāratvaṃ tad api saṃgataṃ gomayāt kīṭāt yogīcchāto mantrād auṣadhāt vṛścikodayavat

tsa-a08-v14.plain_english: There by own-system view we show the constructed.

tsa-a08-v15.plain_english: There the Supreme Lord, full with five powers — thus said; he by freedom manifesting power after power chiefly stands fivefold.
tsa-a08-v15.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvaraḥ pañcabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ nirbhara ity uktam sa svātantryāt śaktiṃ tāṃ tāṃ mukhyatayā prakaṭayan pañcadhā tiṣṭhati

tsa-a08-v16.plain_english: Where awareness leads: Śiva-principle; where bliss leads: power-principle; where will leads: Sadāśiva-principle — for will, of knowing and doing, is of even-acceptance nature; where knowledge-power leads: Īśvara-principle; where action-power leads: knowledge-principle — thus.
tsa-a08-v16.sanskrit_cite: citprādhānye śivatattvam ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam icchāyā hi jñānakriyayoḥ sāmyarūpābhyupagamātmakatvāt jñānaśaktiprādhānye īśvaratattvam kriyāśaktiprādhānye vidyātattvam iti

tsa-a08-v17.plain_english: And here the category-lords: Śiva, Śakti, Sadāśiva, Īśvara, Ananta — like Brahmā in withdrawal; of these common-formed, the particulars with pervasion for object are five — namely Śāmbhavas, Śāktas, Mantramāheśvaras, Mantreśvaras, Mantras — thus the pure path.
tsa-a08-v17.sanskrit_cite: atra ca tattveśvarāḥ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvarānantāḥ brahmeva nivṛttau eṣāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ viśeṣā anugativiṣayāḥ pañca tadyathā śāmbhavāḥ śāktāḥ mantramaheśvarāḥ mantreśvarāḥ mantrā iti śuddhādhvā

tsa-a08-v18.plain_english: So far directly Śiva is maker; but the impure path Aghoreśa, also called Ananta, emits — by the Lord's will-sway, for the enjoyment-perfection of atoms wavered by craving.
tsa-a08-v18.sanskrit_cite: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham

tsa-a08-v19.plain_english: There the waverer, not-full, other-natured form, throbbing, actionless, mere longing — will be future fitness for bounding, thus: not impurity of man, nor another category.
tsa-a08-v19.sanskrit_cite: tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram

tsa-a08-v20.plain_english: But passion-principle is longing bounded by action.

tsa-a08-v21.plain_english: But action there is mere action; mind-nature is passion, varied by action-difference — thus the distinction will be told.
tsa-a08-v21.sanskrit_cite: karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate

tsa-a08-v22.plain_english: It is this impurity from the Supreme Lord's self-veiling wish — nothing else at all a thing; and that too by that Lord-wish-nature alone is the thingness of earth and the rest.
tsa-a08-v22.sanskrit_cite: so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ nānyat kiṃcit vastv api ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt

tsa-a08-v23.plain_english: And it, impurity, existing in the knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction — thus does not fatten its own effect, action.
tsa-a08-v23.sanskrit_cite: sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati

tsa-a08-v24.plain_english: But of the dissolution-kevalin, merely yawning it has been — thus impurity-strengthened action is the cause in transmigration-variety enjoyment — thus for the enjoyment-perfection of atoms pierced by enjoyment-latency of that, glorious Aghoreśa emits — thus it is said fittingly: and the stirring of impurity is by Lord-wish-force alone, for of the inert by itself, anywhere at all, is inability.
tsa-a08-v24.sanskrit_cite: pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam iti tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati iti yuktam uktaṃ malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva jaḍasya svataḥ kutracid api asāmarthyāt

tsa-a08-v25.plain_english: An atom, indeed, is called mere shining of conscious-unconscious-form; of it conscious-form is lordliness alone, unconscious-formedness alone is impurity. And of it emitting, by Lord-wish-made, and thence always of the ever-to-be-emitted-thing-abiding form's to-be-shown-as-inert-ness, inert, all-effect-pervading-formed and pervasive is Māyā-called principle, the material cause; and showing it forth is the Supreme Lord's power named Māyā, quite other than that.
tsa-a08-v25.sanskrit_cite: aṇur nāma kila cidacidrūpāvabhāsa eva tasya cidrūpam aiśvaryam eva acidrūpataiva malaḥ tasya ca sṛjataḥ parameśvarecchāmayaṃ tata eva ca nityaṃ srakṣyamāṇavastugatasya rūpasya jaḍatayābhāsayiṣyamāṇatvāt jaḍaṃ sakalakāryavyāpanādirūpatvāc ca vyāpakaṃ māyākhyaṃ tattvam upādānakāraṇaṃ tadavabhāsakāriṇī ca parameśvarasya māyā nāma śaktis tato 'nyaiva

tsa-a08-v26.plain_english: Thus of kalā-and-rest principles to earth-ended too two-formedness is to be described.
tsa-a08-v26.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalāditattvānāṃ dharāntānām api dvairūpyaṃ nirūpyam

tsa-a08-v27.plain_english: And here proof too have said Abhinavagupta's gurus in two-formedness.
tsa-a08-v27.sanskrit_cite: atra ca dvairūpye pramāṇam api āhur abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

tsa-a08-v28.plain_english: Which in resolve shines, that separated too exists outside, with clear form — like a pot.
tsa-a08-v28.sanskrit_cite: yat saṃkalpe bhāti tat pṛthagbhūtaṃ bahir api asti sphuṭena vapuṣā ghaṭa iva

tsa-a08-v29.plain_english: And thus of Māyā-kalā-and-sky-flowers and the rest too this very course — thus the purely affirmative reason.
tsa-a08-v29.sanskrit_cite: tathā ca māyākalādikhapuṣpāder api eṣaiva vartanī iti kevalānvayī hetuḥ

tsa-a08-v30.plain_english: And by this, those who enjoy knowing of direct-realization-form with Māyā-kalā-nature-mind and the rest as object — they too are perfected, perfected alone.
tsa-a08-v30.sanskrit_cite: anena ca māyākalāprakṛtibuddhyādiviṣayaṃ sākṣātkārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ye bhajante te 'pi siddhāḥ siddhā eva

tsa-a08-v31.plain_english: Thus standing, from Māyā-principle is world-birth.

tsa-a08-v32.plain_english: And it though indeed non-sequential alone, yet by the stated view sequence appears — thus.
tsa-a08-v32.sanskrit_cite: sa ca yady api akramam eva tathāpi uktadṛśā kramo 'vabhāsate iti

tsa-a08-v33.plain_english: And that too is told: there per self the kalā-and-rest group is divided.
tsa-a08-v33.sanskrit_cite: so 'pi ucyate tatra pratyātma kalādivargo bhinnaḥ

tsa-a08-v34.plain_english: From its effect's makership-strengthening and the rest, by self-difference found — but that group sometimes might become one too, by the Lord's wish, like social selves — there all this kalā-and-rest group is pure, which by Lord-objectedness, fit for gaining its nature, doing own work, from world-opposition.
tsa-a08-v34.sanskrit_cite: tatkāryasya kartṛtvopodbalanādeḥ pratyātmabhedena upalambhāt sa tu vargaḥ kadācit ekībhavet api īśvarecchayā sāmājikātmanām iva tatra sarvo 'yaṃ kalādivargaḥ śuddhaḥ yaḥ parameśvaraviṣayatayā tatsvarūpalābhānuguṇanijakāryakārī saṃsārapratidvaṃdvitvāt

tsa-a08-v35.plain_english: And it becomes thus by the Supreme Lord's power-descent sway — thus we shall tell in its showing.
tsa-a08-v35.sanskrit_cite: sa ca parameśvaraśaktipātavaśāt tathā bhavati iti vakṣyāmas tatprakāśane

tsa-a08-v36.plain_english: But the impure is opposite of that.

tsa-a08-v37.plain_english: There from Māyā kalā is born, which yokes the sleeping-placed atom with slight makership; and she, as if swelling, from the union of the two, Māyā and atom, though arisen deforms Māyā, not the undeformable atom — thus Māyā-effect-ness of her.
tsa-a08-v37.sanskrit_cite: tatra māyātaḥ kalā jātā yā suptasthānīyam aṇuṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvena yunakti sā ca ucchūnateva saṃsārabījasya māyāṇvor ubhayoḥ saṃyogāt utpannāpi māyāṃ vikaroti na avikāryam aṇum iti māyākāryatvam asyāḥ

tsa-a08-v38.plain_english: Thus from mutual clinging, indistinguishable inwardness of man-and-kalā.

tsa-a08-v39.plain_english: Māyā-womb officers, but by some lord's grace, when all action ends, Māyā-man discrimination comes about — by which above Māyā sits the knowledge-kevalin; never ever below Māyā is kalā-man discrimination, by which one stands above kalā.
tsa-a08-v39.sanskrit_cite: māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati

tsa-a08-v40.plain_english: Or nature-man discrimination, by which below the chief one would not transmigrate.
tsa-a08-v40.sanskrit_cite: prakṛtipuruṣaviveko vā yena pradhānādho na saṃsaret

tsa-a08-v42.plain_english: But when man's fullness is seen, Śiva-ness alone.

tsa-a08-v43.plain_english: Thus kalā-principle alone is slight-makership-giving, not —
tsa-a08-v43.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalātattvam eva kiṃcitkartṛtvadāyi na ca

tsa-a08-v45.plain_english: Slight-knowing-giving impure knowledge is born from kalā; and knowledge sees mind, and grasps its-lying parts and pleasures and the rest with discrimination.
tsa-a08-v45.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñatvadāyiny aśuddhavidyā kalāto jātā sā ca vidyā buddhiṃ paśyati tadgatāṃś ca sukhādīn vivekena gṛhṇāti

tsa-a08-v46.plain_english: Of mind, of quality-confused form, with discrimination to grasp, from inability.

tsa-a08-v47.plain_english: Hence the mind-mirrored being is discerned by knowledge.

tsa-a08-v48.plain_english: Slight-makership, to perfect some part, somewhere alone makership — in this sense it comes down; but somewhere too in this part is passion-principle's business.
tsa-a08-v48.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ kiṃcidbhāgasiddhaye kvacid eva kartṛtvam ity atra arthe paryavasyati kvacid eva ca ity atra bhāge rāgatattvasya vyāpāraḥ

tsa-a08-v49.plain_english: Not from non-dispassion-made is that — even of non-dispassion, seeing no-attachment.
tsa-a08-v49.sanskrit_cite: na ca avairāgyakṛtaṃ tat avairāgyasyāpi araktidarśanāt

tsa-a08-v50.plain_english: In dispassion, even in duty and the rest, attachment is seen.

tsa-a08-v51.plain_english: Of the sated in food and the rest, though non-dispassion absent, from unremoved inner passion.

tsa-a08-v52.plain_english: By that, without again: from non-dispassion-non-arising contingency.

tsa-a08-v53.plain_english: And time, effect reckoning, reckons makership too bounded by that — in the like, in some-where-ness, this alone makership — thus in this sense is necessity's business.
tsa-a08-v53.sanskrit_cite: kālaś ca kāryaṃ kalayaṃs tadavacchinnaṃ kartṛtvam api kalayati tulye kvacittve asminn eva kartṛtvam ity atrārthe niyater vyāpāraḥ

tsa-a08-v54.plain_english: In cause-effect-ness too hers alone is the business; by that from kalā alone this fourfold is born — this very, slightly now knowing, clinging, I-do — thus-formed awareness, gone to body-city-eight and the rest, is called beast.
tsa-a08-v54.sanskrit_cite: kāryakāraṇabhāve 'pi asyā eva vyāpāraḥ tena kalāta eva etac catuṣkaṃ jātam idam eva kiṃcid adhunā jānan abhiṣvaktaḥ karomi ity evaṃrūpā saṃvid dehapuryaṣṭakādigatā paśur ity ucyate

tsa-a08-v55.plain_english: That this Māyā-and-rest six is called six sheaths.

tsa-a08-v56.plain_english: Of awareness by Māyā, from being set aside, of kalā and the rest falling above, like sheaths from standing.
tsa-a08-v56.sanskrit_cite: saṃvido māyayā apahastitatvena kalādīnām uparipātināṃ kañcukavat avasthānāt

tsa-a08-v57.plain_english: Thus slight-makership which is Māyā-effect; there the slight, but, undistinguished which makership to be qualified; there engaged kalā is the cause of knowledge-and-rest birth — thus described.
tsa-a08-v57.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ yat māyākāryaṃ tatra kiṃcit tv aviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇā kalā vidyādiprasavahetuḥ iti nirūpitam

tsa-a08-v58.plain_english: Now the qualifier part which is called slight is to be known, and the effect — and as long as she, kalā, makes apart from own self, so long this very, of enjoyment-particular interwoven with pleasure-pain-delusion-nature, of mere common, of that-guṇa-sameness-alias, of nature-principle is the emission — thus of enjoyer-enjoyed pair together dependent on kalā-principle is emission.
tsa-a08-v58.sanskrit_cite: idānīṃ viśeṣaṇabhāgo yaḥ kiṃcid ity ukto jñeyaḥ kāryaś ca taṃ yāvat sā kalā svātmanaḥ pṛthak kurute tāvat eṣa eva sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhogyaviśeṣānusyūtasya sāmānyamātrasya tadguṇasāmyāparanāmnaḥ prakṛtitattvasya sargaḥ iti bhoktṛbhogyayugalasya samam eva kalātattvāyattā sṛṣṭiḥ

tsa-a08-v59.plain_english: Here, and of these by the real path, emission is sequence-barren — thus said; sequence-appearing too is, and-is-thus, too said indeed.
tsa-a08-v59.sanskrit_cite: atra caiṣāṃ vāstavena pathā kramavandhyaiva sṛṣṭir ity uktaṃ kramāvabhāso 'pi cāstīty api uktam eva

tsa-a08-v60.plain_english: And sequence of knowledge-passion and the rest, though varied, is seen — someone loving knows, who knowing is loved, and the rest.
tsa-a08-v60.sanskrit_cite: kramaś ca vidyārāgādīnāṃ vicitro 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ kaścid rajyan vetti ko 'pi vidan rajyate ityādi

tsa-a08-v61.plain_english: By that, describing differently, even in Raurava and other scriptures is uncontradicted to be deemed — but that very, become-stirred enjoyed-common: guṇa-principle.
tsa-a08-v61.sanskrit_cite: tena bhinnakramanirūpaṇam api rauravādiṣu śāstreṣu aviruddhaṃ mantavyaṃ tad eva tu bhogyasāmānyaṃ prakṣobhagataṃ guṇatattvam

tsa-a08-v62.plain_english: Where pleasure is enjoyed-form-light: lucidity; pain is light-unlight-swing-natured, hence very action-formed passion; delusion is unlight-formed darkness.
tsa-a08-v62.sanskrit_cite: yatra sukhaṃ bhogyarūpaprakāśaḥ sattvam duḥkhaṃ prakāśāprakāśāndolanātmakam ata eva kriyārūpaṃ rajaḥ mohaḥ prakāśābhāvarūpas tamaḥ

tsa-a08-v64.plain_english: Thus from stirred chief comes to-be-done-arising, not from unstirred — thus.
tsa-a08-v64.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kṣubdhāt pradhānāt kartavyāntarodayaḥ na akṣubdhād iti

tsa-a08-v65.plain_english: Stirring necessarily indeed in between to be assumed: thus proved Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa-principle.
tsa-a08-v65.sanskrit_cite: kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle abhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam

tsa-a08-v66.plain_english: And that stirring from category-lord-presiding alone — otherwise toward fixed man, thus would not succeed.
tsa-a08-v66.sanskrit_cite: sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet

tsa-a08-v67.plain_english: Then from guṇa-principle mind-principle, where man-light and object offer reflection.
tsa-a08-v67.sanskrit_cite: tato guṇatattvāt buddhitattvaṃ yatra puṃprakāśo viṣayaś ca pratibimbam arpayataḥ

tsa-a08-v68.plain_english: From mind-principle I-maker, by which in mind-mirrored object-contact turbid, in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, like silver-pride in shell.
tsa-a08-v68.sanskrit_cite: buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāśe anātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat

tsa-a08-v69.plain_english: Hence indeed making-ness by this is said of it; Sāṃkhya's but that does not fit — for he does not wish self's I-feeling-nature; but we wish makership too of it.
tsa-a08-v69.sanskrit_cite: ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ sāṃkhyasya tu tat na yujyate sa hi na ātmano 'haṃvimarśamayatām icchati vayaṃ tu kartṛtvam api tasya icchāmaḥ

tsa-a08-v70.plain_english: And that pure deliberation alone, non-rivalled, own-self-wonder-formed I — thus.
tsa-a08-v70.sanskrit_cite: tac ca śuddhaṃ vimarśa eva apratiyogi svātmacamatkārarūpo 'ham iti

tsa-a08-v71.plain_english: This is of it, of I-maker: instrument-heap.

tsa-a08-v72.plain_english: But nature-heap of it alone is threefold, by lucidity-and-rest difference.

tsa-a08-v73.plain_english: There the lucid, from which mind and the five mind-senses — and there in mind, in the generable, endowed with all-subtle-birth power, it is the begetter.
tsa-a08-v73.sanskrit_cite: tatra sāttviko yasmāt manaś ca buddhīndriyapañcakaṃ ca tatra manasi janye sarvatanmātrajananasāmarthyayuktaḥ sa janakaḥ

tsa-a08-v74.plain_english: In ear, distinguished by sound-birth power — thus; up to nose, fit with smell-birth fitness — thus elemental is not fitting: since I hear and the rest following, clearly I-maker-ness; and by instrument-ness necessarily maker-part-touching-ness; otherwise, if another instrument is joined, from regress-and-rest befalling.
tsa-a08-v74.sanskrit_cite: śrotre tu śabdajananasāmarthyaviśiṣṭa iti yāvat ghrāṇe gandhajananayogyatāyukta iti bhautikam api na yuktam ahaṃ śṛṇomi ityādyanugamāc ca sphuṭam āhaṃkārikatvam karaṇatvena ca avaśyaṃ kartraṃśasparśitvam anyathā karaṇāntarayojanāyām anavasthādyāpātāt

tsa-a08-v75.plain_english: And the maker-part is I-maker alone; by that two chief instruments: in knowing knowledge, in doing kalā — of the blind and of the lame; and from non-leaving of I-formed knowing-doing, from excelling in subtle-part, but from just the lucid I-maker, the five action-senses — I go, thus distinguished as I-maker, fit for effect-instrument; the foot-sense, its chief seat is outer, elsewhere too that is indeed — thus even of the crippled there is no going-break.
tsa-a08-v75.sanskrit_cite: kartraṃśaś ca ahaṃkāra eva tena mukhye karaṇe dve puṃsaḥ jñāne vidyā kriyāyāṃ kalā andhasya paṅgoś ca ahaṃtārūpajñānakriyānapagamāt udriktatanmātrabhāgaviśiṣṭāt tu sāttvikād eva ahaṃkārāt karmendriyapañcakam ahaṃ gacchāmi iti ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭaḥ kāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ pādendriyaṃ tasya mukhyādhiṣṭhānaṃ bāhyam anyatrāpi tad asty eva iti rugṇasyāpi na gativicchedaḥ

tsa-a08-v76.plain_english: And not from duty-confusion-freed alone, for the reason action is instrument-effected; and chief of goings and the rest is action-ness, not of form-and-rest grasping; of it, in Kaṇāda's system, since quality — hence necessarily to be admitted is the action-sense group.
tsa-a08-v76.sanskrit_cite: na ca kartavyasāṃkaryamuktād eva hetoḥ kriyā karaṇakāryā mukhyaṃ ca gamanādīnāṃ kriyātvaṃ na rūpādyupalambhasya tasya kāṇādatantre guṇatvāt tasmāt avaśyābhyupeyaḥ karmendriyavargaḥ

tsa-a08-v77.plain_english: And it, the pentad, from so-much-ness of joining.

tsa-a08-v78.plain_english: Thus indeed: outside — first for giving up, or joining; for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for own-nature rest — there in order: anus, hand, foot, lap — thus.
tsa-a08-v78.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi bahis tāvat tyāgāya vā anusaṃdhiḥ ādānāya vā dvayāya vā ubhayarahitatvena svarūpaviśrāntaye vā tatra krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda upastha iti

tsa-a08-v79.plain_english: But within, in breath-seat-action joining, the speech-sense; by that, in sense-seat, in hand, whatever going, that too is foot-sense's alone doing — thus to be deemed; by that action-endlessness too does not bring sense-endlessness; to this extent of the rajasic clinging — thus they say.
tsa-a08-v79.sanskrit_cite: antaḥ prāṇāśrayakarmānusaṃdhes tu vāgindriyam tena indriyādhiṣṭhāne haste yat gamanaṃ tad api pādendriyasyaiva karma iti mantavyam tena karmānantyam api na indriyānantyam āvahet iyati rājasasya upaśleṣakatvam ity āhuḥ

tsa-a08-v80.plain_english: Others: from rajasic, mind — they say.
tsa-a08-v80.sanskrit_cite: anye tu rājasān mana ity āhuḥ

tsa-a08-v81.plain_english: Others: from lucid, mind; and from passionate, senses — thus.
tsa-a08-v81.sanskrit_cite: anye tu sāttvikāt mano rājasāc ca indriyāṇi iti

tsa-a08-v82.plain_english: But from enjoyer-part-coverer, from darkness-ruled I-maker, the subtle elements, knowable-one-formed, five.
tsa-a08-v82.sanskrit_cite: bhoktraṃśāc chādakāt tu tamaḥpradhānāhaṃkārāt tanmātrāṇi vedyaikarūpāṇi pañca

tsa-a08-v83.plain_english: Of sound-particulars, for stirring-natured, which one, unstirred-natured, pre-existent, common, undistinguished-natured — that is sound-subtle.
tsa-a08-v83.sanskrit_cite: śabdaviśeṣāṇāṃ hi kṣobhātmanāṃ yad ekam akṣobhātmakaṃ prāgbhāvi sāmānyam aviśeṣātmakaṃ tat śabdatanmātram

tsa-a08-v84.plain_english: Thus up to smell too is to be said.

tsa-a08-v85.plain_english: There from stirred sound-subtle: space-giving-business ether; of sound, since bearing word-superimposition-room.
tsa-a08-v85.sanskrit_cite: tatra śabdatanmātrāt kṣubhitāt avakāśadānavyāpāraṃ nabhaḥ śabdasya vācyādhyāsāvakāśasahatvāt

tsa-a08-v86.plain_english: Sound-subtle stirred is wind; but sound of it is by ether from non-absence.
tsa-a08-v86.sanskrit_cite: śabdatanmātraṃ kṣubhitaṃ vāyuḥ śabdas tu asya nabhasā virahābhāvāt

tsa-a08-v87.plain_english: Form stirred is fire; the two earlier as before.
tsa-a08-v87.sanskrit_cite: rūpaṃ kṣubhitaṃ tejaḥ pūrvaguṇau tu pūrvavat

tsa-a08-v88.plain_english: Taste stirred is waters; the earlier three as before.
tsa-a08-v88.sanskrit_cite: rasaḥ kṣubhita āpaḥ pūrve trayaḥ pūrvavat

tsa-a08-v89.plain_english: Smell stirred is earth; the earlier four as before.
tsa-a08-v89.sanskrit_cite: gandhaḥ kṣubhito dharā pūrve catvāraḥ pūrvavat

tsa-a08-v90.plain_english: Others: by sound-touch, wind; in and-the-rest order, from five, ground — they think.

tsa-a08-v93.plain_english: It alone is the excellence of quality: that without it, another quality does not arise; by that, earth-principle, from Śiva-principle beginning, is pervaded by water-principle — thus water by fire, and the rest, up to power-principle.
