Whatever form pervading only some differences: a category; as earth pervading all world-eggs.
Categories' cause-effect-ness shown; twofold.
Ultimate, and of emission.
Ultimate cause-effect: free agent-Lord's showing-forth with Śiva-to-earth body, non-different, resting in own nature.
Constructed cause-effect by Lord's will with necessity-breath; fixed before-after appearing; sprout from seed, wish, dream, pots.
Lord's agency never lapsing; unconstructed too the ultimate stands.
Wall-like standing ultimate; all drawn fits; assemblage alone caused-ness fitting.
All-being weave of free awareness; fixed own place-time-thing nature; deviation scales effect-difference.
Free-awareness Lord world-bodied maker of pots; potter-awareness nothing beyond; potter-pride Lord-made like pots.
Assemblage-doctrine strengthens awareness-alone makership.
On Meru no such pot would be.
Constructed caused-ness many-typed fits: dung worms, wish, mantra, herbs; scorpion-arising.
By own-system view the constructed shown.
Lord full with five powers; manifesting chiefly stands fivefold.
Awareness/bliss/will-led: Śiva/power/Sadāśiva; will even-acceptance; knowledge/action-led: Īśvara/knowledge.
Lords Śiva-Ananta; like Brahmā withdrawn; five pervasion-object particulars: pure path.
Directly Śiva maker; impure path Aghoreśa-Ananta emits for wavered atoms' enjoyment.
Waverer incomplete other-natured throbbing mere longing, future bounding-fitness: not impurity nor another category.
Passion-principle: action-bounded longing.
Action mere action; mind-nature passion varied by action-difference; distinction to be told.
Impurity: Lord's self-veiling wish; nothing else; earth-and-rest's thingness only thus.
Knowledge-kevalin impurity facing destruction fattens not action; dissolution-kevalin's yawning impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-enjoyment.
For enjoyment-pierced atoms Aghoreśa emits; fittingly said; stirring by Lord-wish-force alone; inert by itself anywhere unable.
Atom: mere conscious-unconscious shining; conscious lordliness, unconscious impurity; emitting by Lord-wish-made; inert all-effect-pervading Māyā-principle material cause; Lord's Māyā-power distinct.
Kalā-to-earth too two-formedness to be described.
Gurus cited as proof of two-formedness.
What shines in resolve exists outside too, like a pot.
Māyā-kalā-sky-flowers too this course: purely affirmative reason.
Direct-realizers of Māyā-objects perfected indeed.
From Māyā-principle world-birth.
Non-sequential yet by stated view sequential appearing.
Per self the kalā-group divided.
Effect-makership found by self-difference; group may unite by wish like social selves; pure Lord-objected work-doers from world-opposition.
By power-descent sway becoming thus; to be told in its showing.
Impure opposite of that.
Māyā-born kalā yokes sleeping atom with slight makership; swelling, deforms Māyā not undeformable atom: her Māyā-effect-ness.
Mutual clinging: indistinguishable man-kalā inwardness.
Māyā-womb officers by grace at action-end: Māyā-man then kalā-man discriminations, stationed above.
Nature-man discrimination: below-the-chief non-transmigration.
Impurity-man discrimination: Śiva-likeness.
Man's fullness seen: Śiva-ness alone.
Kalā-principle alone slight-makership-giving, not —
makership of the unknowing.
Slight-knowing-giving impure knowledge from kalā; sees mind; grasps parts discriminately.
Quality-confused mind unable to grasp discriminately.
Mind-mirrored being discerned by knowledge.
Slight makership somewhere alone; passion's business in the part.
Not from dispassion; non-attachment seen even of dispassionate.
In dispassion duty and the rest attachment seen.
Sated in food yet inner passion unremoved.
Without it non-dispassion-non-arising contingency.
Time reckoning effect reckons bounded makership; in this sense necessity's business.
Her business; kalā-born fourfold; clinging I-do awareness gone to body-city-eight: beast.
Māyā-and-rest six called six sheaths.
Awareness set aside by Māyā; above-falling kalā stands sheath-like.
Slight Māyā-effect makership; but undistinguished to-be-qualified; engaged kalā births knowledge-and-rest.
Qualifier part called slight; kalā's apart-making emits enjoyed-common; pair-emission kalā-dependent.
Real path barren yet appearing sequential: both said.
Loving-knowing order varied; both directions seen.
Varied order in Raurava uncontradicted; stirred enjoyed-common: guṇa-principle.
Pleasure enjoyed-form-light lucidity; pain swing-formed action passion; delusion darkness.
Triad all enjoyed-formed.
Stirred chief yields effects, not unstirred.
Stirring assumed between; Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa.
Without lord-presiding, no fixed-man success.
From guṇa mind; man-light and object reflect.
In turbid mind-mirror non-self self-pride like silver in shell.
We keep I-feeling and makership; Sāṃkhya fits neither.
Pure I: non-rivalled wonder-formed deliberation.
I-maker's instrument-heap named.
Nature-heap threefold by guṇa difference.
Lucid begets mind and five senses with all-subtle-birth power.
Sense-powers prove I-maker-ness; regress bars extra instruments.
Two chief instruments knowledge/kalā; blind-lame I-ness; five action-senses; foot outer-seated; no break for crippled.
Going is action not grasping; Kaṇāda agrees; action-sense group admitted.
Pentad from joining-measure.
Five openings by five functions.
Hand-going is foot's doing; no sense-infinity.
Others: mind from rajasic.
Others: mind lucid-born, senses passionate-born.
Darkness-ruled I yields five knowable-formed subtle elements.
Pre-existent undistinguished common: sound-subtle.
Same account through smell.
Stirred sound-subtle gives space-room ether.
Stirred sound-subtle wind; sound needs ether.
Stirred form fire with two earlier.
Stirred taste waters with three earlier.
Stirred smell earth with four earlier.
Others derive ground from five.
Earth heap of qualities, no bearer.
Higher pervades; lower is pervaded.
Excellence needs lower; earth pervaded Śiva-down to water, up to power.

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes tattva-definition (whole vs partial pervasion), the two cause-effect-nesses (ultimate self-showing vs constructed willed order with sprout-seed-wish-dream proof), agency never lapsing, the wall simile, sāmagrī doctrine with deviation-scaling, the potter proof (Lord-maker, potter-pride Lord-made), Meru test, constructed variety (dung-to-scorpion), own-system five-power standing with five principles and pure-path lords, Aghoreśa-Ananta impure path for wavered atoms, craving vs impurity vs passion vs action distinctions, impurity as self-veiling wish, kevalin economics, atom-Māyā analysis (material cause vs distinct power), kalā-to-earth two-formedness with guru proof and pot rule, world-birth from Māyā with sequential-appearing, kalā-group purity, kalā's yoking-swelling-deforming, man-kalā clinging, grace discriminations to Śiva-ness, kañcuka economics (impure knowledge, confused mind, mirrored discernment, somewhere-makership, passion's part, dispassion debates, time-necessity, beast-definition, six sheaths, engaged kalā), enjoyed-common emission with barren-yet-appearing sequence, order-variety, guṇa natures, stirring-need with Sāṃkhya separated guṇa, presiding-need, mind/I-maker genesis with shell-silver simile against Sāṃkhya, pure I, heaps, lucid begetting, sense-proofs with regress bar, chief instruments with blind-lame I-ness and foot-seat, action-sense admission with Kaṇāda, pentad measure, five openings, hand-foot unity, others' views, darkness-ruled subtle elements, sound-subtle with pre-existent common, element births to earth-as-heap, and pervasion proof closing at power.

sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) definitions — whole-pervasion Paramaśiva, partial-pervasion tattva with earth example, twofold cause-effect named; (2) ultimate vs constructed — Lord's self-showing body, willed fixed order with seed-wish-dream-pot proof, agency kept, wall simile; (3) sāmagrī — weave doctrine, deviation-scaling, potter proof with pride-dissolution, Meru test; (4) variety — dung-to-scorpion fitting, own-system promise, five-power standing, five principles with will-as-even-acceptance, pure-path lords; (5) impure path — Śiva-then-Aghoreśa, waverer analysis (longing not impurity), passion/action split, impurity-as-veiling-wish, kevalin economics, atom-Māyā analysis; (6) two-formedness — kalā-to-earth extension, guru proof, pot rule, sky-flowers, siddhas, world-birth, sequential-appearing, kalā-group purity; (7) kalā mechanics — yoking, swelling, deforming, clinging, grace discriminations to Śiva-ness, slight-makership limits, impure knowledge, confused mind, mirrored discernment, somewhere-makership, passion's part, dispassion debates, time-necessity, beast-definition, six sheaths, engaged kalā; (8) enjoyed-common — qualifier part, apart-making emission, barren-yet-appearing, order-variety, Raurava compatibility, guṇa natures, stirring-need; (9) mind genesis — presiding-need, guṇa-to-mind reflection, shell-silver self-pride, anti-Sāṃkhya I-keeping, pure I, heaps; (10) senses — lucid begetting, sense-proofs, regress bar, chief instruments, blind-lame I-ness, foot-seat, Kaṇāda admission, pentad, openings, hand-foot unity, others' views; (11) elements — darkness-ruled subtle elements, pre-existent sound-subtle common, same-through-smell, ether/wind/fire/waters/earth births, others' derivation, earth-as-heap, pervasion proof to power.

lines: This world-born glory, wombing endless enjoyers, enjoyed —
what runs through all as mighty light: the commonest Whole, high Śiva.
tsa-a08-v01.sanskrit_cite: yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam

lines: What runs through some few parts alone is real;
as earth — glow-hard, stay-thick — through every world-egg ruled.
tsa-a08-v02.sanskrit_cite: yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvaṃ yathā pṛthivī nāma dyutikāṭhinyasthaulyādirūpā kālāgniprabhṛtivīrabhadrāntabhuvaneśādhiṣṭhitasamastabrahmāṇḍānugatā

lines: Of these reals cause-effect is shown —
and it is two.
tsa-a08-v03.sanskrit_cite: tatra eṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo darśyate sa ca dvividhaḥ

lines: The last, and the forth-sent.
Here the last cause-work is just this: the free Lord's self,
agent-natured, in Śiva-to-earth flesh,
same-natured, self-resting, shines.
tsa-a08-v05.sanskrit_cite: tatra pāramārthika etāvān kāryakāraṇabhāvo yad uta kartṛsvabhāvasya svatantrasya bhagavata evaṃvidhena śivādidharāntena vapuṣā svarūpabhinnena svarūpaviśrāntena ca prathanam

lines: But the built cause-work the Lord's will wove, fate-threaded:
hold the fixed first-later show, even beyond, still self-true,
only so — so from yogin's wish, from seed the sprout,
in dream and beyond, pots and the like.
tsa-a08-v06.sanskrit_cite: kalpitas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ parameśecchayā niyatiprāṇayā nirmitaḥ sa ca yāvati yadā niyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsanaṃ saty api adhike svarūpānugatam etāvaty eva tena yogīcchāto 'pi aṅkuro bījād api svapnādau ghaṭāder apīti

lines: And there the Highest's act never falls away —
so the unbuilt real stands true.
tsa-a08-v07.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi ca parameśvarasya kartṛtvānapāya iti akalpito 'pi asau pāramārthikaḥ sthita eva

lines: For given the true's wall-like steadiness,
all this drawn fits, else not.
So by the mass alone causation befits.
tsa-a08-v08.sanskrit_cite: pāramārthike hi bhittisthānīye sthite rūpe sarvam idam ullikhyamānaṃ ghaṭate na anyathā ata eva sāmagryā eva kāruṇatvaṃ yuktam

lines: For she, thought-swollen mass-woven by free knowing's might,
thus of fixed own place-time-thing nature —
as each thing ripens true, being so;
in being-so, being-other, as it grows,
so the deed's out-kindness by degrees is fed.
tsa-a08-v09.sanskrit_cite: sā hi samastabhāvasaṃdarbhamayī svatantrasaṃvedanamahimnā tathā niyatanijanijadeśakālabhāvarāśisvabhāvā pratyekaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣpattisamaye tathābhūtā tathābhūtāyā hi anyathābhāvo yathā yathā adhikībhavati tathā tathā kāryasyāpi vijātīyatvaṃ tāratamyena puṣyati

lines: So bright-knowing-free, the Highest alone,
world-stuff bodied, pots and the like he builds —
for pot-mind is nothing beyond him,
and the pot-body cast amid thing-masses —
how is the pot-body's maker-pride?
Then thus: the Highest-made even that shall be, like pots and the like.
tsa-a08-v10.sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvedanasvātantryasvabhāvaḥ parameśvara eva viśvabhāvaśarīro ghaṭāder nirmātā kumbhakārasaṃvidas tato 'nadhikatvāt kumbhakāraśarīrasya ca bhāvarāśimadhye nikṣepāt kathaṃ kumbhakāraśarīrasya kartṛtvābhimānaḥ iti cet parameśvarakṛta evāsau ghaṭādivat bhaviṣyati

lines: Hence the mass-creed too the world-bodied knowing's making alone upholds.
tsa-a08-v11.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sāmagrīvādo 'pi viśvaśarīrasya saṃvedanasyaiva kartṛtāyām upodbalakaḥ

lines: On Meru there a pot such as that cannot be.
tsa-a08-v12.sanskrit_cite: merau hi tatrasthe na bhavet tathāvidho ghaṭaḥ

lines: Thus in the built causation the manifold kinds among reals the scripture speaks — that too fits —
dung-born worms, yogin's wish, spell, herbs: as grubs to scorpions.
tsa-a08-v13.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalpite 'smin kāryatve śāstreṣu tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ prati yat bahuprakāratvaṃ tad api saṃgataṃ gomayāt kīṭāt yogīcchāto mantrād auṣadhāt vṛścikodayavat

lines: Here by our own system's ken we set forth the built.
Here the Highest, with five mights replete,
they say; who, by his free will, displaying might on might,
stands fivefold.
tsa-a08-v15.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvaraḥ pañcabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ nirbhara ity uktam sa svātantryāt śaktiṃ tāṃ tāṃ mukhyatayā prakaṭayan pañcadhā tiṣṭhati

lines: Where knowing leads, the Śiva-truth; where bliss, the might-truth;
where will, the Eternally-blest-truth —
for will is of knowing and acting, of even embracing nature;
where knowing-might leads is the Sovereign-truth,
where doing-might, the lore-truth.
tsa-a08-v16.sanskrit_cite: citprādhānye śivatattvam ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam icchāyā hi jñānakriyayoḥ sāmyarūpābhyupagamātmakatvāt jñānaśaktiprādhānye īśvaratattvam kriyāśaktiprādhānye vidyātattvam iti

lines: Here the truth-lords — Śiva, Might, the Ever-blest, Sovereign, the Boundless —
like great-father Brahmā withdrawn from all;
of these broad-run forms, five special kinds traverse the pasture:
the blessed-wise, the mighty, the great spell-lords, the spell-lords, the spells — pure path.
tsa-a08-v17.sanskrit_cite: atra ca tattveśvarāḥ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvarānantāḥ brahmeva nivṛttau eṣāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ viśeṣā anugativiṣayāḥ pañca tadyathā śāmbhavāḥ śāktāḥ mantramaheśvarāḥ mantreśvarāḥ mantrā iti śuddhādhvā

lines: Thus far straight Śiva makes; but the foul path
Unbounded, alias Aghoreśa, pours —
by the Highest's will-sway, for the waverers' bliss-seedlings.
tsa-a08-v18.sanskrit_cite: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham

lines: The waverer, not quite full, other-wise formed, astir,
deedless, mere craving — to be bounding-fit hereafter —
is no taint of man, nor another real.
tsa-a08-v19.sanskrit_cite: tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram

lines: But passion-principle is the bounded by deed.
But deed is mere deed there;
thought-nature is passion, stark by deed-sorts —
so the cut shall be told.
tsa-a08-v21.sanskrit_cite: karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate

lines: That is the taint the Highest's veiling-scheme willed —
nothing else at all a thing though;
and lo, by that Highest-willed self alone is earth and all things true.
tsa-a08-v22.sanskrit_cite: so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ nānyat kiṃcit vastv api ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt

lines: Of the sage-knower that seed leans dissolving, so swells not its act;
but the rot-bound yawns forever, so that swollen seed
fruits nights and days of wandering-delight.
tsa-a08-v23.sanskrit_cite: sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati

lines: So bright Aghoreśa pours for the bliss of the pierced by thing-hunger's tale —
well-sung truth; for the taint's stir
comes from the Highest's wish alone; alone the dead cannot anywhere.
tsa-a08-v24.sanskrit_cite: pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam iti tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati iti yuktam uktaṃ malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva jaḍasya svataḥ kutracid api asāmarthyāt

lines: An atom they say is just the shining of consciousness and its lack;
we call its knowing form lordship alone;
its non-knowing shape is the taint; and for its springing by Highest-will's making,
and because what shall be poured forever in things must seem inert as stone,
because all-doing is pervaded, the Invisible-born is Māyā-reality:
material cause of all;
and the light of it that shows forth is the Highest's Māyā-might —
far other than that.
tsa-a08-v25.sanskrit_cite: aṇur nāma kila cidacidrūpāvabhāsa eva tasya cidrūpam aiśvaryam eva acidrūpataiva malaḥ tasya ca sṛjataḥ parameśvarecchāmayaṃ tata eva ca nityaṃ srakṣyamāṇavastugatasya rūpasya jaḍatayābhāsayiṣyamāṇatvāt jaḍaṃ sakalakāryavyāpanādirūpatvāc ca vyāpakaṃ māyākhyaṃ tattvam upādānakāraṇaṃ tadavabhāsakāriṇī ca parameśvarasya māyā nāma śaktis tato 'nyaiva

lines: Thus in the long chain of principles earth-ward,
two-foldness must be shown.
tsa-a08-v26.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalāditattvānāṃ dharāntānām api dvairūpyaṃ nirūpyam

lines: Here beyond chapter and number, ev'n Abhinava's masters said:
tsa-a08-v27.sanskrit_cite: atra ca dvairūpye pramāṇam api āhur abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

lines: What gleams in a thought gleams beyond it —
as clear as if upon a cake —
it is.
tsa-a08-v28.sanskrit_cite: yat saṃkalpe bhāti tat pṛthagbhūtaṃ bahir api asti sphuṭena vapuṣā ghaṭa iva

lines: So with Māyā, her spit, heaven-flowers and such
runs ever this same ritual — pure in outcome, plain.
tsa-a08-v29.sanskrit_cite: tathā ca māyākalādikhapuṣpāder api eṣaiva vartanī iti kevalānvayī hetuḥ

lines: And he who takes for wisdom what he finds
in Māyā, spit, root, wit and the like —
he too is saint, saint through and through.
tsa-a08-v30.sanskrit_cite: anena ca māyākalāprakṛtibuddhyādiviṣayaṃ sākṣātkārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ye bhajante te 'pi siddhāḥ siddhā eva

lines: Thus abiding, from Māyā-principle the world's womb.
And though in rankless rows it flows,
yet by the sight announced it shines in ranks.
tsa-a08-v32.sanskrit_cite: sa ca yady api akramam eva tathāpi uktadṛśā kramo 'vabhāsate iti

lines: And this is said: here for each soul its group of kalā — cut asunder.
tsa-a08-v33.sanskrit_cite: so 'pi ucyate tatra pratyātma kalādivargo bhinnaḥ

lines: Its labour's strength confirms it, each soul meeting itself;
but just then it joins, at the Highest's will,
like social selves —
here all this kalā-throng is pure, which, through
god-aimed ends, realizing self, does its appointed work,
to strive against the world's return.
tsa-a08-v34.sanskrit_cite: tatkāryasya kartṛtvopodbalanādeḥ pratyātmabhedena upalambhāt sa tu vargaḥ kadācit ekībhavet api īśvarecchayā sāmājikātmanām iva tatra sarvo 'yaṃ kalādivargaḥ śuddhaḥ yaḥ parameśvaraviṣayatayā tatsvarūpalābhānuguṇanijakāryakārī saṃsārapratidvaṃdvitvāt

lines: And it grows thus by the falling of
Down-looking Power: as is told when that is told.
tsa-a08-v35.sanskrit_cite: sa ca parameśvaraśaktipātavaśāt tathā bhavati iti vakṣyāmas tatprakāśane

lines: But the impure is its inversion.
Māyā bore kalā, which yokes the sleeping pearl
with acting at all; and she, swelling as she does
as the world's seed — from Māyā and spirit their congress,
though risen, she twists Māyā the changeless,
but not the changeless spirit — so she is Māyā's fruit.
tsa-a08-v37.sanskrit_cite: tatra māyātaḥ kalā jātā yā suptasthānīyam aṇuṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvena yunakti sā ca ucchūnateva saṃsārabījasya māyāṇvor ubhayoḥ saṃyogāt utpannāpi māyāṃ vikaroti na avikāryam aṇum iti māyākāryatvam asyāḥ

lines: Thus their embrace makes between man and kalā
no inner difference to be found.
Who rule the Māyā-womb, by some Ish's grace
when their action all falls dead — discernment seeps
of Man from Māyā: above Māyā the sage
keeps lone; below her never the kalā-self call,
whereby above kalā presides.
tsa-a08-v39.sanskrit_cite: māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati

lines: Else man-and-root discern, whereby, below
the Primal, no return.
tsa-a08-v40.sanskrit_cite: prakṛtipuruṣaviveko vā yena pradhānādho na saṃsaret

lines: In the sameness of no self and self, equality with Śiva.
But in the mind that sees the person as full:
just the Śiva-state.
Thus kalā-truth alone, who grants partial making, and not.
tsa-a08-v43.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalātattvam eva kiṃcitkartṛtvadāyi na ca

lines: The non-sage's making.
From kalā up-springing, sight-less ken reveals:
she, Knowledge, sees Mind, and by discrimination
takes all its essence, all pleasures, to her own.
tsa-a08-v45.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñatvadāyiny aśuddhavidyā kalāto jātā sā ca vidyā buddhiṃ paśyati tadgatāṃś ca sukhādīn vivekena gṛhṇāti

lines: For the mind by quality entangled cannot by severance take.
Hence by her reliance do we find the mind-seen Image.
It is making slight, elsewhere perfected, makings alone;
in this sense it settles; and now attention was paid
to the point of rajas.
tsa-a08-v48.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ kiṃcidbhāgasiddhaye kvacid eva kartṛtvam ity atra arthe paryavasyati kvacid eva ca ity atra bhāge rāgatattvasya vyāpāraḥ

lines: Not from lack of pain is this the truth —
since he who lacks pain feels no pain.
tsa-a08-v49.sanskrit_cite: na ca avairāgyakṛtaṃ tat avairāgyasyāpi araktidarśanāt

lines: In dispassion, even fate and the like, he found attachment.
Sated with food and the rest, though dispassion be gone,
the inward crimson never ebbs.
By this, again, lest dispassion fail to rise.
And Time, effecting the deed, effects too the bounded deed —
in the like, in each case, this very making:
in this sense is Necessity's play.
tsa-a08-v53.sanskrit_cite: kālaś ca kāryaṃ kalayaṃs tadavacchinnaṃ kartṛtvam api kalayati tulye kvacittve asminn eva kartṛtvam ity atrārthe niyater vyāpāraḥ

lines: In cause and act too hers alone is the play;
hence from kalā the four are born:
even this, a little knowing, clinging, 'I do' —
thus-formed awareness, gone to body, fort, eight and the rest —
is called the beast.
tsa-a08-v54.sanskrit_cite: kāryakāraṇabhāve 'pi asyā eva vyāpāraḥ tena kalāta eva etac catuṣkaṃ jātam idam eva kiṃcid adhunā jānan abhiṣvaktaḥ karomi ity evaṃrūpā saṃvid dehapuryaṣṭakādigatā paśur ity ucyate

lines: That Māyā-and-the-rest six is called the six sheaths.
For awareness by Māyā set aside, kalā and the rest falling above
stand sheath-like.
tsa-a08-v56.sanskrit_cite: saṃvido māyayā apahastitatvena kalādīnām uparipātināṃ kañcukavat avasthānāt

lines: Thus slight making, Māyā's fruit; there the slight, yet undistinguished,
which making to be made distinct; there busy kalā
is the cause whence knowing and the rest are born — so reckoned.
tsa-a08-v57.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ yat māyākāryaṃ tatra kiṃcit tv aviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇā kalā vidyādiprasavahetuḥ iti nirūpitam

lines: Now for the qualifier part called slight to be known, and the deed —
till she, kalā, parts it from herself,
even this, the enjoyed-common inwoven with pleasure, pain, delusion —
the mere common, the fellow of that sameness —
nature's truth flows forth;
so the enjoyer-and-enjoyed pair, together, from kalā-truth depends.
tsa-a08-v58.sanskrit_cite: idānīṃ viśeṣaṇabhāgo yaḥ kiṃcid ity ukto jñeyaḥ kāryaś ca taṃ yāvat sā kalā svātmanaḥ pṛthak kurute tāvat eṣa eva sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhogyaviśeṣānusyūtasya sāmānyamātrasya tadguṇasāmyāparanāmnaḥ prakṛtitattvasya sargaḥ iti bhoktṛbhogyayugalasya samam eva kalātattvāyattā sṛṣṭiḥ

lines: Here too by the real road emission is sequence-barren — said;
sequence-appearing is too, and so said.
tsa-a08-v59.sanskrit_cite: atra caiṣāṃ vāstavena pathā kramavandhyaiva sṛṣṭir ity uktaṃ kramāvabhāso 'pi cāstīty api uktam eva

lines: And order, though of knowing, passion and the rest, is seen manifold —
one loving knows, another knowing loves, and so forth.
tsa-a08-v60.sanskrit_cite: kramaś ca vidyārāgādīnāṃ vicitro 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ kaścid rajyan vetti ko 'pi vidan rajyate ityādi

lines: Thus by that the varied telling, even in Raurava and the rest, stands unrefuted;
but that very, become stirred, is the enjoyed-common: the strand-truth.
tsa-a08-v61.sanskrit_cite: tena bhinnakramanirūpaṇam api rauravādiṣu śāstreṣu aviruddhaṃ mantavyaṃ tad eva tu bhogyasāmānyaṃ prakṣobhagataṃ guṇatattvam

lines: Where pleasure is enjoyed-form's light: lucidity;
sorrow, light-unlight swinging, hence action-formed passion;
delusion, unlight-formed, darkness.
tsa-a08-v62.sanskrit_cite: yatra sukhaṃ bhogyarūpaprakāśaḥ sattvam duḥkhaṃ prakāśāprakāśāndolanātmakam ata eva kriyārūpaṃ rajaḥ mohaḥ prakāśābhāvarūpas tamaḥ

lines: All the triad too is enjoyed-formed.
Thus from the stirred First Order the after-deed arises, not from the unstirred.
tsa-a08-v64.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kṣubdhāt pradhānāt kartavyāntarodayaḥ na akṣubdhād iti

lines: The stirring must needs be granted in between: thus proved,
Sāṃkhya-seen, the parted strand-truth.
tsa-a08-v65.sanskrit_cite: kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle abhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam

lines: And that stirring from the category-lords' presiding alone —
else toward fixed man it would not speed.
tsa-a08-v66.sanskrit_cite: sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet

lines: Then from strand-truth mind-truth, where man-light and thing
give back the shine.
tsa-a08-v67.sanskrit_cite: tato guṇatattvāt buddhitattvaṃ yatra puṃprakāśo viṣayaś ca pratibimbam arpayataḥ

lines: From mind-truth the I-maker, whereby in mind-mirrored thing-touch turbid,
in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, as silver-pride in shell.
tsa-a08-v68.sanskrit_cite: buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāśe anātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat

lines: Hence indeed the making is by this declared of it; Sāṃkhya's own
fits not — for selfhood's I-feeling he wishes not;
but we wish its making too.
tsa-a08-v69.sanskrit_cite: ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ sāṃkhyasya tu tat na yujyate sa hi na ātmano 'haṃvimarśamayatām icchati vayaṃ tu kartṛtvam api tasya icchāmaḥ

lines: And that pure musing alone, uncountered, self-wonder-formed — I.
tsa-a08-v70.sanskrit_cite: tac ca śuddhaṃ vimarśa eva apratiyogi svātmacamatkārarūpo 'ham iti

lines: This is his, the I-maker's, engine-heap.
But the root-heap of it alone is threefold, by bright and the rest.
There the bright, whence mind and the five mind-senses —
there in mind to be born, endowed with all-subtle-birth might: it the begetter.
tsa-a08-v73.sanskrit_cite: tatra sāttviko yasmāt manaś ca buddhīndriyapañcakaṃ ca tatra manasi janye sarvatanmātrajananasāmarthyayuktaḥ sa janakaḥ

lines: In ear, by sound-birth might distinguished — thus;
up to nose, by smell-birth fitness — thus;
no mere element befits — since 'I hear' and the rest runs through,
plain is I-maker-ness; and by engine-ness needs must
touch the maker-part — else, were another engine yoked,
ruin and the rest would fall.
tsa-a08-v74.sanskrit_cite: śrotre tu śabdajananasāmarthyaviśiṣṭa iti yāvat ghrāṇe gandhajananayogyatāyukta iti bhautikam api na yuktam ahaṃ śṛṇomi ityādyanugamāc ca sphuṭam āhaṃkārikatvam karaṇatvena ca avaśyaṃ kartraṃśasparśitvam anyathā karaṇāntarayojanāyām anavasthādyāpātāt

lines: And the maker-part is I-maker alone; by that two chief engines:
in knowing, knowing; in doing, doing-power;
for blind and lame, unfallen from I-formed knowing-doing;
but from the bright alone, in subtles part-excelling, the I-maker —
the five deed-engines; 'I go,' I-maker-marked —
fit for deed and engine; foot-engine its chief seat without,
elsewhere too that is indeed — so not even of the halt is going broke.
tsa-a08-v75.sanskrit_cite: kartraṃśaś ca ahaṃkāra eva tena mukhye karaṇe dve puṃsaḥ jñāne vidyā kriyāyāṃ kalā andhasya paṅgoś ca ahaṃtārūpajñānakriyānapagamāt udriktatanmātrabhāgaviśiṣṭāt tu sāttvikād eva ahaṃkārāt karmendriyapañcakam ahaṃ gacchāmi iti ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭaḥ kāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ pādendriyaṃ tasya mukhyādhiṣṭhānaṃ bāhyam anyatrāpi tad asty eva iti rugṇasyāpi na gativicchedaḥ

lines: And not freed from ought-to-do's confusion alone is the cause:
deed is engine-wrought, chief;
and of goings and the rest is deed-ness, not of form-and-rest grasping;
of it, in Kaṇāda's reckoning, since strand-ness —
hence the deed-engine host must needs be granted.
tsa-a08-v76.sanskrit_cite: na ca kartavyasāṃkaryamuktād eva hetoḥ kriyā karaṇakāryā mukhyaṃ ca gamanādīnāṃ kriyātvaṃ na rūpādyupalambhasya tasya kāṇādatantre guṇatvāt tasmāt avaśyābhyupeyaḥ karmendriyavargaḥ

lines: And it, the five, from joining's so-much-ness.
Thus look without: first for giving up, or joining;
for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for self-nature rest —
there in order: breech, hand, foot, lap.
tsa-a08-v78.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi bahis tāvat tyāgāya vā anusaṃdhiḥ ādānāya vā dvayāya vā ubhayarahitatvena svarūpaviśrāntaye vā tatra krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda upastha iti

lines: But within, in breath-home-deed joining: the voice-engine;
by that, in engine's seat, in hand, what going, that too
is foot-engine's alone doing — so deem; by that deed-countless
brings not engine-countless;
to this height the lustrous clings — they say.
tsa-a08-v79.sanskrit_cite: antaḥ prāṇāśrayakarmānusaṃdhes tu vāgindriyam tena indriyādhiṣṭhāne haste yat gamanaṃ tad api pādendriyasyaiva karma iti mantavyam tena karmānantyam api na indriyānantyam āvahet iyati rājasasya upaśleṣakatvam ity āhuḥ

lines: Others: from the lustrous, mind — they say.
tsa-a08-v80.sanskrit_cite: anye tu rājasān mana ity āhuḥ

lines: Others: from the bright, mind; and from the lustful, senses.
tsa-a08-v81.sanskrit_cite: anye tu sāttvikāt mano rājasāc ca indriyāṇi iti

lines: But from enjoyer-bit-shrouder, from gloom-ruled I-maker:
the wisps, one-knowable-formed, five.
tsa-a08-v82.sanskrit_cite: bhoktraṃśāc chādakāt tu tamaḥpradhānāhaṃkārāt tanmātrāṇi vedyaikarūpāṇi pañca

lines: Of sound-bits, for stir-natured, which one unstirred-natured, fore-being,
common, undistinguished — that is sound-wisp.
tsa-a08-v83.sanskrit_cite: śabdaviśeṣāṇāṃ hi kṣobhātmanāṃ yad ekam akṣobhātmakaṃ prāgbhāvi sāmānyam aviśeṣātmakaṃ tat śabdatanmātram

lines: So up to smell's end too the saying goes.
There from stirred sound-wisp: space-dealing room, the sky;
of sound, since bearing word-laid room.
tsa-a08-v85.sanskrit_cite: tatra śabdatanmātrāt kṣubhitāt avakāśadānavyāpāraṃ nabhaḥ śabdasya vācyādhyāsāvakāśasahatvāt

lines: Sound-wisp stirred is gale; but its sound is by sky, from no-without.
tsa-a08-v86.sanskrit_cite: śabdatanmātraṃ kṣubhitaṃ vāyuḥ śabdas tu asya nabhasā virahābhāvāt

lines: Form stirred is glow; the two before as before.
tsa-a08-v87.sanskrit_cite: rūpaṃ kṣubhitaṃ tejaḥ pūrvaguṇau tu pūrvavat

lines: Sap stirred is floods; the three before as before.
tsa-a08-v88.sanskrit_cite: rasaḥ kṣubhita āpaḥ pūrve trayaḥ pūrvavat

lines: Smell stirred is ground; the four before as before.
tsa-a08-v89.sanskrit_cite: gandhaḥ kṣubhito dharā pūrve catvāraḥ pūrvavat

lines: Others: by sound-touch, gale; in this-and-that order, from five, ground — they deem.
tsa-a08-v90.sanskrit_cite: anye śabdasparśābhyāṃ vāyuḥ ityādikrameṇa pañcabhyo dharaṇī iti manyante

lines: Mere mass of strands is earth; no other strand-bearer at all.
tsa-a08-v91.sanskrit_cite: guṇasamudāyamātraṃ ca pṛthivī nānyo guṇī kaścit

lines: And in this truth-throng, the higher-higher-stranded is spreading;
the lower-stranded, spread.
tsa-a08-v92.sanskrit_cite: asmiṃś ca tattvakalāpe ūrdhvordhvaguṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ nikṛṣṭaguṇaṃ tu vyāpyam

lines: Alone it is the strand's pride: without it, no other strand stands;
hence earth-truth, from Śiva-truth on, by water-truth is spread —
so water by glow, and the rest, till might-truth.
tsa-a08-v93.sanskrit_cite: sa eva guṇasya utkarṣo yat tena vinā guṇāntaraṃ na upapadyate tena pṛthivītattvaṃ śivatattvāt prabhṛti jalatattvena vyāptam evaṃ jalaṃ tejasā ityādi yāvac chaktitattvam

lines: This world-born glory, wombing endless enjoyers, enjoyed —
what runs through all as mighty light: the commonest Whole, high Śiva.
tsa-a08-v01.sanskrit_cite: yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam

lines: What runs through some few parts alone is real;
as earth — glow-hard, stay-thick — through every world-egg ruled.
tsa-a08-v02.sanskrit_cite: yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvaṃ yathā pṛthivī nāma dyutikāṭhinyasthaulyādirūpā kālāgniprabhṛtivīrabhadrāntabhuvaneśādhiṣṭhitasamastabrahmāṇḍānugatā

lines: Of these reals cause-effect is shown —
and it is two.
tsa-a08-v03.sanskrit_cite: tatra eṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo darśyate sa ca dvividhaḥ

lines: The last, and the forth-sent.
Here the last cause-work is just this: the free Lord's self,
agent-natured, in Śiva-to-earth flesh,
same-natured, self-resting, shines.
tsa-a08-v05.sanskrit_cite: tatra pāramārthika etāvān kāryakāraṇabhāvo yad uta kartṛsvabhāvasya svatantrasya bhagavata evaṃvidhena śivādidharāntena vapuṣā svarūpabhinnena svarūpaviśrāntena ca prathanam

lines: But the built cause-work the Lord's will wove, fate-threaded:
hold the fixed first-later show, even beyond, still self-true,
only so — so from yogin's wish, from seed the sprout,
in dream and beyond, pots and the like.
tsa-a08-v06.sanskrit_cite: kalpitas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ parameśecchayā niyatiprāṇayā nirmitaḥ sa ca yāvati yadā niyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsanaṃ saty api adhike svarūpānugatam etāvaty eva tena yogīcchāto 'pi aṅkuro bījād api svapnādau ghaṭāder apīti

lines: And there the Highest's act never falls away —
so the unbuilt real stands true.
tsa-a08-v07.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi ca parameśvarasya kartṛtvānapāya iti akalpito 'pi asau pāramārthikaḥ sthita eva

lines: For given the true's wall-like steadiness,
all this drawn fits, else not.
So by the mass alone causation befits.
tsa-a08-v08.sanskrit_cite: pāramārthike hi bhittisthānīye sthite rūpe sarvam idam ullikhyamānaṃ ghaṭate na anyathā ata eva sāmagryā eva kāruṇatvaṃ yuktam

lines: For she, thought-swollen mass-woven by free knowing's might,
thus of fixed own place-time-thing nature —
as each thing ripens true, being so;
in being-so, being-other, as it grows,
so the deed's out-kindness by degrees is fed.
tsa-a08-v09.sanskrit_cite: sā hi samastabhāvasaṃdarbhamayī svatantrasaṃvedanamahimnā tathā niyatanijanijadeśakālabhāvarāśisvabhāvā pratyekaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣpattisamaye tathābhūtā tathābhūtāyā hi anyathābhāvo yathā yathā adhikībhavati tathā tathā kāryasyāpi vijātīyatvaṃ tāratamyena puṣyati

lines: So bright-knowing-free, the Highest alone,
world-stuff bodied, pots and the like he builds —
for pot-mind is nothing beyond him,
and the pot-body cast amid thing-masses —
how is the pot-body's maker-pride?
Then thus: the Highest-made even that shall be, like pots and the like.
tsa-a08-v10.sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvedanasvātantryasvabhāvaḥ parameśvara eva viśvabhāvaśarīro ghaṭāder nirmātā kumbhakārasaṃvidas tato 'nadhikatvāt kumbhakāraśarīrasya ca bhāvarāśimadhye nikṣepāt kathaṃ kumbhakāraśarīrasya kartṛtvābhimānaḥ iti cet parameśvarakṛta evāsau ghaṭādivat bhaviṣyati

lines: Hence the mass-creed too the world-bodied knowing's making alone upholds.
tsa-a08-v11.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sāmagrīvādo 'pi viśvaśarīrasya saṃvedanasyaiva kartṛtāyām upodbalakaḥ

lines: On Meru there a pot such as that cannot be.
tsa-a08-v12.sanskrit_cite: merau hi tatrasthe na bhavet tathāvidho ghaṭaḥ

lines: Thus in the built causation the manifold kinds among reals the scripture speaks — that too fits —
dung-born worms, yogin's wish, spell, herbs: as grubs to scorpions.
tsa-a08-v13.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalpite 'smin kāryatve śāstreṣu tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ prati yat bahuprakāratvaṃ tad api saṃgataṃ gomayāt kīṭāt yogīcchāto mantrād auṣadhāt vṛścikodayavat

lines: Here by our own system's ken we set forth the built.
Here the Highest, with five mights replete,
they say; who, by his free will, displaying might on might,
stands fivefold.
tsa-a08-v15.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvaraḥ pañcabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ nirbhara ity uktam sa svātantryāt śaktiṃ tāṃ tāṃ mukhyatayā prakaṭayan pañcadhā tiṣṭhati

lines: Where knowing leads, the Śiva-truth; where bliss, the might-truth;
where will, the Eternally-blest-truth —
for will is of knowing and acting, of even embracing nature;
where knowing-might leads is the Sovereign-truth,
where doing-might, the lore-truth.
tsa-a08-v16.sanskrit_cite: citprādhānye śivatattvam ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam icchāyā hi jñānakriyayoḥ sāmyarūpābhyupagamātmakatvāt jñānaśaktiprādhānye īśvaratattvam kriyāśaktiprādhānye vidyātattvam iti

lines: Here the truth-lords — Śiva, Might, the Ever-blest, Sovereign, the Boundless —
like great-father Brahmā withdrawn from all;
of these broad-run forms, five special kinds traverse the pasture:
the blessed-wise, the mighty, the great spell-lords, the spell-lords, the spells — pure path.
tsa-a08-v17.sanskrit_cite: atra ca tattveśvarāḥ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvarānantāḥ brahmeva nivṛttau eṣāṃ sāmānyarūpāṇāṃ viśeṣā anugativiṣayāḥ pañca tadyathā śāmbhavāḥ śāktāḥ mantramaheśvarāḥ mantreśvarāḥ mantrā iti śuddhādhvā

lines: Thus far straight Śiva makes; but the foul path
Unbounded, alias Aghoreśa, pours —
by the Highest's will-sway, for the waverers' bliss-seedlings.
tsa-a08-v18.sanskrit_cite: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham

lines: The waverer, not quite full, other-wise formed, astir,
deedless, mere craving — to be bounding-fit hereafter —
is no taint of man, nor another real.
tsa-a08-v19.sanskrit_cite: tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram

lines: But passion-principle is the bounded by deed.
But deed is mere deed there;
thought-nature is passion, stark by deed-sorts —
so the cut shall be told.
tsa-a08-v21.sanskrit_cite: karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate

lines: That is the taint the Highest's veiling-scheme willed —
nothing else at all a thing though;
and lo, by that Highest-willed self alone is earth and all things true.
tsa-a08-v22.sanskrit_cite: so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ nānyat kiṃcit vastv api ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt

lines: Of the sage-knower that seed leans dissolving, so swells not its act;
but the rot-bound yawns forever, so that swollen seed
fruits nights and days of wandering-delight.
tsa-a08-v23.sanskrit_cite: sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati

lines: So bright Aghoreśa pours for the bliss of the pierced by thing-hunger's tale —
well-sung truth; for the taint's stir
comes from the Highest's wish alone; alone the dead cannot anywhere.
tsa-a08-v24.sanskrit_cite: pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam iti tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati iti yuktam uktaṃ malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva jaḍasya svataḥ kutracid api asāmarthyāt

lines: An atom they say is just the shining of consciousness and its lack;
we call its knowing form lordship alone;
its non-knowing shape is the taint; and for its springing by Highest-will's making,
and because what shall be poured forever in things must seem inert as stone,
because all-doing is pervaded, the Invisible-born is Māyā-reality:
material cause of all;
and the light of it that shows forth is the Highest's Māyā-might —
far other than that.
tsa-a08-v25.sanskrit_cite: aṇur nāma kila cidacidrūpāvabhāsa eva tasya cidrūpam aiśvaryam eva acidrūpataiva malaḥ tasya ca sṛjataḥ parameśvarecchāmayaṃ tata eva ca nityaṃ srakṣyamāṇavastugatasya rūpasya jaḍatayābhāsayiṣyamāṇatvāt jaḍaṃ sakalakāryavyāpanādirūpatvāc ca vyāpakaṃ māyākhyaṃ tattvam upādānakāraṇaṃ tadavabhāsakāriṇī ca parameśvarasya māyā nāma śaktis tato 'nyaiva

lines: Thus in the long chain of principles earth-ward,
two-foldness must be shown.
tsa-a08-v26.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalāditattvānāṃ dharāntānām api dvairūpyaṃ nirūpyam

lines: Here beyond chapter and number, ev'n Abhinava's masters said:
tsa-a08-v27.sanskrit_cite: atra ca dvairūpye pramāṇam api āhur abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

lines: What gleams in a thought gleams beyond it —
as clear as if upon a cake —
it is.
tsa-a08-v28.sanskrit_cite: yat saṃkalpe bhāti tat pṛthagbhūtaṃ bahir api asti sphuṭena vapuṣā ghaṭa iva

lines: So with Māyā, her spit, heaven-flowers and such
runs ever this same ritual — pure in outcome, plain.
tsa-a08-v29.sanskrit_cite: tathā ca māyākalādikhapuṣpāder api eṣaiva vartanī iti kevalānvayī hetuḥ

lines: And he who takes for wisdom what he finds
in Māyā, spit, root, wit and the like —
he too is saint, saint through and through.
tsa-a08-v30.sanskrit_cite: anena ca māyākalāprakṛtibuddhyādiviṣayaṃ sākṣātkārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ye bhajante te 'pi siddhāḥ siddhā eva

lines: Thus abiding, from Māyā-principle the world's womb.
And though in rankless rows it flows,
yet by the sight announced it shines in ranks.
tsa-a08-v32.sanskrit_cite: sa ca yady api akramam eva tathāpi uktadṛśā kramo 'vabhāsate iti

lines: And this is said: here for each soul its group of kalā — cut asunder.
tsa-a08-v33.sanskrit_cite: so 'pi ucyate tatra pratyātma kalādivargo bhinnaḥ

lines: Its labour's strength confirms it, each soul meeting itself;
but just then it joins, at the Highest's will,
like social selves —
here all this kalā-throng is pure, which, through
god-aimed ends, realizing self, does its appointed work,
to strive against the world's return.
tsa-a08-v34.sanskrit_cite: tatkāryasya kartṛtvopodbalanādeḥ pratyātmabhedena upalambhāt sa tu vargaḥ kadācit ekībhavet api īśvarecchayā sāmājikātmanām iva tatra sarvo 'yaṃ kalādivargaḥ śuddhaḥ yaḥ parameśvaraviṣayatayā tatsvarūpalābhānuguṇanijakāryakārī saṃsārapratidvaṃdvitvāt

lines: And it grows thus by the falling of
Down-looking Power: as is told when that is told.
tsa-a08-v35.sanskrit_cite: sa ca parameśvaraśaktipātavaśāt tathā bhavati iti vakṣyāmas tatprakāśane

lines: But the impure is its inversion.
Māyā bore kalā, which yokes the sleeping pearl
with acting at all; and she, swelling as she does
as the world's seed — from Māyā and spirit their congress,
though risen, she twists Māyā the changeless,
but not the changeless spirit — so she is Māyā's fruit.
tsa-a08-v37.sanskrit_cite: tatra māyātaḥ kalā jātā yā suptasthānīyam aṇuṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvena yunakti sā ca ucchūnateva saṃsārabījasya māyāṇvor ubhayoḥ saṃyogāt utpannāpi māyāṃ vikaroti na avikāryam aṇum iti māyākāryatvam asyāḥ

lines: Thus their embrace makes between man and kalā
no inner difference to be found.
Who rule the Māyā-womb, by some Ish's grace
when their action all falls dead — discernment seeps
of Man from Māyā: above Māyā the sage
keeps lone; below her never the kalā-self call,
whereby above kalā presides.
tsa-a08-v39.sanskrit_cite: māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati

lines: Else man-and-root discern, whereby, below
the Primal, no return.
tsa-a08-v40.sanskrit_cite: prakṛtipuruṣaviveko vā yena pradhānādho na saṃsaret

lines: In the sameness of no self and self, equality with Śiva.
But in the mind that sees the person as full:
just the Śiva-state.
Thus kalā-truth alone, who grants partial making, and not.
tsa-a08-v43.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalātattvam eva kiṃcitkartṛtvadāyi na ca

lines: The non-sage's making.
From kalā up-springing, sight-less ken reveals:
she, Knowledge, sees Mind, and by discrimination
takes all its essence, all pleasures, to her own.
tsa-a08-v45.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñatvadāyiny aśuddhavidyā kalāto jātā sā ca vidyā buddhiṃ paśyati tadgatāṃś ca sukhādīn vivekena gṛhṇāti

lines: For the mind by quality entangled cannot by severance take.
Hence by her reliance do we find the mind-seen Image.
It is making slight, elsewhere perfected, makings alone;
in this sense it settles; and now attention was paid
to the point of rajas.
tsa-a08-v48.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ kiṃcidbhāgasiddhaye kvacid eva kartṛtvam ity atra arthe paryavasyati kvacid eva ca ity atra bhāge rāgatattvasya vyāpāraḥ

lines: Not from lack of pain is this the truth —
since he who lacks pain feels no pain.
tsa-a08-v49.sanskrit_cite: na ca avairāgyakṛtaṃ tat avairāgyasyāpi araktidarśanāt

lines: In dispassion, even fate and the like, he found attachment.
Of the sated with food and the rest, though passion be not,
for the inner crimson is just the same.
By this, again, without any relapse into passion.
And Time, in the Act which he effects,
measures his making by that limit —
in the like, in every some, the making is just the same;
in this sense Fate's play is marked.
tsa-a08-v53.sanskrit_cite: kālaś ca kāryaṃ kalayaṃs tadavacchinnaṃ kartṛtvam api kalayati tulye kvacittve asminn eva kartṛtvam ity atrārthe niyater vyāpāraḥ

lines: In cause and act, and even in hers the play is done;
hence from kalā the fourfold is born:
even this knowledge, so far-seeing, the scholar
I make — thus wise, that awareness
in the body, in fort, in eight-ness even —
they call the beast.
tsa-a08-v54.sanskrit_cite: kāryakāraṇabhāve 'pi asyā eva vyāpāraḥ tena kalāta eva etac catuṣkaṃ jātam idam eva kiṃcid adhunā jānan abhiṣvaktaḥ karomi ity evaṃrūpā saṃvid dehapuryaṣṭakādigatā paśur ity ucyate

lines: And that sixfold māyā-ness is called the six sheaths.
For śakti set aside by the gods,
but kalā and the rest that slip on and off
are sheath-like amid the standing.
tsa-a08-v56.sanskrit_cite: saṃvido māyayā apahastitatvena kalādīnām uparipātināṃ kañcukavat avasthānāt

lines: Thus, even so slight making — when truth is weighed,
a might of Māyā; where ingenuity is kindled,
what right acting needs to be made visible;
now, having kindled all her fire,
Māyā must eventually give birth to this — so it is reckoned.
tsa-a08-v57.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ yat māyākāryaṃ tatra kiṃcit tv aviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇā kalā vidyādiprasavahetuḥ iti nirūpitam

lines: Now the qualifier part called slight to be known, and the deed —
till she, kalā, parts it from herself,
even this, the enjoyed-common inwoven with pleasure, pain, delusion —
the mere common, fellow of that sameness —
nature's truth flows forth;
so the enjoyer-and-enjoyed pair, together, on kalā-truth depends.
tsa-a08-v58.sanskrit_cite: idānīṃ viśeṣaṇabhāgo yaḥ kiṃcid ity ukto jñeyaḥ kāryaś ca taṃ yāvat sā kalā svātmanaḥ pṛthak kurute tāvat eṣa eva sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhogyaviśeṣānusyūtasya sāmānyamātrasya tadguṇasāmyāparanāmnaḥ prakṛtitattvasya sargaḥ iti bhoktṛbhogyayugalasya samam eva kalātattvāyattā sṛṣṭiḥ

lines: Here too by the real road emission is sequence-barren — said;
sequence-appearing is too, and so said.
tsa-a08-v59.sanskrit_cite: atra caiṣāṃ vāstavena pathā kramavandhyaiva sṛṣṭir ity uktaṃ kramāvabhāso 'pi cāstīty api uktam eva

lines: And lo, those of knowledge, devotion, and the rest
are seen in their separate fire;
some embracing, some knowing the bliss;
one is another's actor.
tsa-a08-v60.sanskrit_cite: kramaś ca vidyārāgādīnāṃ vicitro 'pi dṛṣṭaḥ kaścid rajyan vetti ko 'pi vidan rajyate ityādi

lines: Thus by that the varied telling, even in Raurava and the rest, stands unrefuted;
but that very, become stirred, is the enjoyed-common: the strand-truth.
tsa-a08-v61.sanskrit_cite: tena bhinnakramanirūpaṇam api rauravādiṣu śāstreṣu aviruddhaṃ mantavyaṃ tad eva tu bhogyasāmānyaṃ prakṣobhagataṃ guṇatattvam

lines: Where happiness meets the light of fruition,
that is lucidity; where sorrow swings
through light and unlight, there is motion;
where illusion sees no light,
that is tamas.
tsa-a08-v62.sanskrit_cite: yatra sukhaṃ bhogyarūpaprakāśaḥ sattvam duḥkhaṃ prakāśāprakāśāndolanātmakam ata eva kriyārūpaṃ rajaḥ mohaḥ prakāśābhāvarūpas tamaḥ

lines: All the triad too is enjoyed-formed.
Thus from the stirred First Order there comes
the after-worked and the after-to-do, and no other.
tsa-a08-v64.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kṣubdhāt pradhānāt kartavyāntarodayaḥ na akṣubdhād iti

lines: The stirring must needs be granted in between: thus proved,
Sāṃkhya-seen, the parted strand-truth.
tsa-a08-v65.sanskrit_cite: kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle abhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam

lines: And that stirring from the category-lords' presiding alone —
else toward fixed man it would not speed.
tsa-a08-v66.sanskrit_cite: sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet

lines: Then from tamas' truth the wit-truth came,
where manhood-lightning and the faces
give back the reflection.
tsa-a08-v67.sanskrit_cite: tato guṇatattvāt buddhitattvaṃ yatra puṃprakāśo viṣayaś ca pratibimbam arpayataḥ

lines: From mind-truth the I-maker, whereby in mind-mirrored thing-touch turbid,
in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, as silver-pride in shell.
tsa-a08-v68.sanskrit_cite: buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāśe anātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat

lines: Hence indeed the making is by this declared of it; Sāṃkhya's own
fits not — for selfhood's I-feeling he wishes not;
but we wish its making too.
tsa-a08-v69.sanskrit_cite: ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ sāṃkhyasya tu tat na yujyate sa hi na ātmano 'haṃvimarśamayatām icchati vayaṃ tu kartṛtvam api tasya icchāmaḥ

lines: And that pure musing alone, uncountered, self-wonder-formed — I.
tsa-a08-v70.sanskrit_cite: tac ca śuddhaṃ vimarśa eva apratiyogi svātmacamatkārarūpo 'ham iti

lines: This is his, the I-maker's, engine-heap.
But the root-heap of it alone is threefold, by bright and the rest.
There the bright, whence mind and the five mind-senses —
there in mind to be born, endowed with all-subtle-birth might: it the begetter.
tsa-a08-v73.sanskrit_cite: tatra sāttviko yasmāt manaś ca buddhīndriyapañcakaṃ ca tatra manasi janye sarvatanmātrajananasāmarthyayuktaḥ sa janakaḥ

lines: In ear, by sound-birth might distinguished — thus;
up to nose, by smell-birth fitness — thus;
no mere element befits — since 'I hear' and the rest runs through,
plain is I-maker-ness; and by engine-ness needs must
touch the maker-part — else, were another engine yoked,
ruin and the rest would fall.
tsa-a08-v74.sanskrit_cite: śrotre tu śabdajananasāmarthyaviśiṣṭa iti yāvat ghrāṇe gandhajananayogyatāyukta iti bhautikam api na yuktam ahaṃ śṛṇomi ityādyanugamāc ca sphuṭam āhaṃkārikatvam karaṇatvena ca avaśyaṃ kartraṃśasparśitvam anyathā karaṇāntarayojanāyām anavasthādyāpātāt

lines: And the maker-part is I-maker alone; by that two chief engines:
in knowing, knowing; in doing, doing-power;
for blind and lame, unfallen from I-formed knowing-doing;
but from the bright alone, part-excelling in subtles, the I-maker —
the five deed-engines; 'I go,' I-maker-marked —
fit for deed and engine; foot-engine its chief seat without,
elsewhere too that is indeed — so not even of the halt is going broke.
tsa-a08-v75.sanskrit_cite: kartraṃśaś ca ahaṃkāra eva tena mukhye karaṇe dve puṃsaḥ jñāne vidyā kriyāyāṃ kalā andhasya paṅgoś ca ahaṃtārūpajñānakriyānapagamāt udriktatanmātrabhāgaviśiṣṭāt tu sāttvikād eva ahaṃkārāt karmendriyapañcakam ahaṃ gacchāmi iti ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭaḥ kāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ pādendriyaṃ tasya mukhyādhiṣṭhānaṃ bāhyam anyatrāpi tad asty eva iti rugṇasyāpi na gativicchedaḥ

lines: And not freed from ought-to-do's confusion alone is the cause:
deed is engine-wrought, chief;
and of goings and the rest is deed-ness, not of form-and-rest grasping;
of it, in Kaṇāda's reckoning, since strand-ness —
hence the deed-engine host must needs be granted.
tsa-a08-v76.sanskrit_cite: na ca kartavyasāṃkaryamuktād eva hetoḥ kriyā karaṇakāryā mukhyaṃ ca gamanādīnāṃ kriyātvaṃ na rūpādyupalambhasya tasya kāṇādatantre guṇatvāt tasmāt avaśyābhyupeyaḥ karmendriyavargaḥ

lines: And it, the five, from joining's so-much-ness.
Thus look without: first for giving up, or joining;
for taking, or for both, or by both-less-ness for self-nature rest —
there in order: breech, hand, foot, lap.
tsa-a08-v78.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi bahis tāvat tyāgāya vā anusaṃdhiḥ ādānāya vā dvayāya vā ubhayarahitatvena svarūpaviśrāntaye vā tatra krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda upastha iti

lines: But within, in breath-home-deed joining: the voice-engine;
by that, in engine's seat, in hand, what going, that too
is foot-engine's alone doing — so deem; by that deed-countless
brings not engine-countless;
to this height the lustrous clings — they say.
tsa-a08-v79.sanskrit_cite: antaḥ prāṇāśrayakarmānusaṃdhes tu vāgindriyam tena indriyādhiṣṭhāne haste yat gamanaṃ tad api pādendriyasyaiva karma iti mantavyam tena karmānantyam api na indriyānantyam āvahet iyati rājasasya upaśleṣakatvam ity āhuḥ

lines: Others: from the lustrous, mind — they say.
tsa-a08-v80.sanskrit_cite: anye tu rājasān mana ity āhuḥ

lines: Others: from the bright, mind; and from the lustful, senses.
tsa-a08-v81.sanskrit_cite: anye tu sāttvikāt mano rājasāc ca indriyāṇi iti

lines: But from enjoyer-bit-shrouder, from gloom-ruled I-maker:
the wisps, one-knowable-formed, five.
tsa-a08-v82.sanskrit_cite: bhoktraṃśāc chādakāt tu tamaḥpradhānāhaṃkārāt tanmātrāṇi vedyaikarūpāṇi pañca

lines: Of sound-bits, for stir-natured, which one unstirred-natured, fore-being,
common, undistinguished — that is sound-wisp.
tsa-a08-v83.sanskrit_cite: śabdaviśeṣāṇāṃ hi kṣobhātmanāṃ yad ekam akṣobhātmakaṃ prāgbhāvi sāmānyam aviśeṣātmakaṃ tat śabdatanmātram

lines: So up to smell's end too the saying goes.
There from stirred sound-wisp: space-dealing room, the sky;
of sound, since bearing word-laid room.
tsa-a08-v85.sanskrit_cite: tatra śabdatanmātrāt kṣubhitāt avakāśadānavyāpāraṃ nabhaḥ śabdasya vācyādhyāsāvakāśasahatvāt

lines: Sound-wisp stirred is gale; but its sound is by sky, from no-without.
tsa-a08-v86.sanskrit_cite: śabdatanmātraṃ kṣubhitaṃ vāyuḥ śabdas tu asya nabhasā virahābhāvāt

lines: Form stirred is glow; the two before as before.
tsa-a08-v87.sanskrit_cite: rūpaṃ kṣubhitaṃ tejaḥ pūrvaguṇau tu pūrvavat

lines: Sap stirred is floods; the three before as before.
tsa-a08-v88.sanskrit_cite: rasaḥ kṣubhita āpaḥ pūrve trayaḥ pūrvavat

lines: Smell stirred is ground; the four before as before.
tsa-a08-v89.sanskrit_cite: gandhaḥ kṣubhito dharā pūrve catvāraḥ pūrvavat

lines: Others: by sound-touch, gale; in this-and-that order, from five, ground — they deem.
tsa-a08-v90.sanskrit_cite: anye śabdasparśābhyāṃ vāyuḥ ityādikrameṇa pañcabhyo dharaṇī iti manyante

lines: Mere mass of strands is earth; no other strand-bearer at all.
tsa-a08-v91.sanskrit_cite: guṇasamudāyamātraṃ ca pṛthivī nānyo guṇī kaścit

lines: And in this truth-throng, the higher-higher-stranded is spreading;
the lower-stranded, spread.
tsa-a08-v92.sanskrit_cite: asmiṃś ca tattvakalāpe ūrdhvordhvaguṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ nikṛṣṭaguṇaṃ tu vyāpyam

lines: Alone it is the strand's pride: without it, no other strand stands;
hence earth-truth, from Śiva-truth on, by water-truth is spread —
so water by glow, and the rest, till might-truth.
tsa-a08-v93.sanskrit_cite: sa eva guṇasya utkarṣo yat tena vinā guṇāntaraṃ na upapadyate tena pṛthivītattvaṃ śivatattvāt prabhṛti jalatattvena vyāptam evaṃ jalaṃ tejasā ityādi yāvac chaktitattvam
